To put a thing into service for what it can do. Also the custom that repeated employment hardens into.
To come into possession of. Retrieving what already exists, rather than making it.
The declared shape of a thing. The form something is held in, named before it is filled.
One line in an ordered set. A single record standing in succession with its kind.
What is given to a process from outside it. What a system receives before it can answer.
To place a thing into what already stands. First a graft: a living shoot joined into established stock so the two grow as one.
The least value a thing may take. A floor stated in advance.
A support set beneath a thing to keep it standing. First a stake under a growing vine.
An ordered enumeration of things. First the strip of cloth at an edge - the border became the record written along it.
To bring forth what did not exist before. The same root as kin and kind - to generate is to beget.
The return toward a former state after damage. Recovery is rarely restoration — what returns is changed.
The shape a thing holds, and the mould that holds it. Both the outline seen and the instrument that makes the outline.
A thing that holds, and a thing that carries. The same word for the cup and the ship - and for a living body understood as either.
A kind, recognised by the marks its members share. From the impression a blow leaves behind - the shape struck once and repeated after.
How much of a thing there is, measured against a standard. First a ruling handed down - the amount an authority fixed as right.
Being here, and being felt to be here. Presence is more than location — it is attention actually given.
The things that are given. Facts handed over as the ground a reckoning stands on, before anything is concluded from them.
The act of finding a thing sound enough to stand. Its root is not correctness but strength - to validate is to confirm something can bear weight.
A group whose members share a rank or kind. From the Roman summons - a class was first the people called out together.
Speaking of what has not yet happened, and turning out right. Prophecy is recognised only afterward.
The mark showing how much lies beyond the frame and where you are within it. It measures the unseen.
Short form of medium, and of medical. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
An ordered set of pieces chosen to be heard together. The choosing and the ordering are both authorship.
A likeness that stands in for the thing itself. An image trusted to carry meaning without explaining it.
Belonging to the people at large, and open to them. Not the absence of privacy but the presence of everyone.
A held collection of records, kept in order. First a literal thread - documents strung on a wire so they could be found again.
A single leaf holding one thing at a time. From the papyrus sheet, and beneath that from the verb to scratch - a card is a surface marked so it can be read.
What comes back after a thing is done. From the Latin for rebound - a result is the leap returning, not the leap.
The condition a thing stands in at a given moment. From standing itself - a state is a posture held, not a permanence.
One who puts a thing into service. An agent named only by the act, which is why the word says nothing about who they are.
What a thing holds inside it. From the same root as contentment - to be content is to have one's wants bounded by what is already held.
A flat surface things are set out on, and the ordered arrangement set out there. First a plank cut for inscribing.
A thing that is. Being itself, named as a noun so it can be counted and pointed at.
A drawn correspondence between a territory and a surface small enough to hold. Named for the cloth it was drawn on, not for the land.
To give something that was asked for, by the authority to give it. Its root is not gift but trust - to grant is to find the asking credible.
Is able to. The word that names a capacity rather than an act.
One entry among others in a list. Not originally a thing at all - the Latin word for 'also', repeated down a page until the marker became the thing it marked.
A form worth repeating, held up as the thing to copy. The same word as patron - a pattern is what stands over the work as its example.
Base-sixteen notation, used to write colours and bytes compactly. A named encoding rather than a concept.
Knowing that one knows. Its root is not solitary awareness but KNOWING WITH - the Latin says two parties share what is known.
The giving of life to what has none. From breath - to animate is to breathe into a thing until it moves as if it were alive.
To flatten a structured thing into a sequence that can be stored or sent. Serialisation trades shape for portability.
The outline of a thing seen from the side. A shape drawn by its edge alone, showing what a full view would hide.
A binding that holds two things together while leaving them two. From tying, not from merging.
The one shaped thing that opens a particular lock. What grants entry by fitting, not by force.
To cease. A stop is an ending that could have continued, which is what distinguishes it from finishing.
A bounded field over which something holds sway. From the house - a domain is first the reach of one lord's roof, and only later a field of knowledge.
Short form of equaliser, and of equals. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
Where a thing stands at present. The condition it is in, understood as a position rather than a nature.
To meet another with acknowledgment. A greeting says I see you before it says anything else.
That which digs through a mass to find what is worth keeping. A miner moves far more than it takes.
A body called together to deliberate. From the shout that summons - a council is not a group that exists, but a group that was CALLED.
A small raised thing made to be pressed or fastened. Etymologically a bud - something that pushes out from a surface.
That which holds other things and gives them a bound. From holding-together, the same root as content and contentment.
A named class that things are sorted into. Its Greek root is TO SPEAK AGAINST - to categorise was first to accuse, and only later to assert.
Words joined into a fabric. Literally a thing woven - a text is threads crossed until they hold together.
Extent with room in it. What is stretched open so something can be placed, or so nothing need be.
A part obtained by cutting the whole. Not a natural joint but a chosen one - a section is where someone decided to divide.
A going astray. Not a fault but a WANDERING - the word says one left the path, and says nothing about blame.
A doing, considered as a thing. The moment a capacity stops being potential and moves.
What a thing is worth. From the same root as strength and valour - value is not price but the capacity to hold up.
A way worn by being walked. Not built - a path is the record that others went first.
A touching between two things. Also the person reachable through it, named for the touch rather than the bond.
To draw a part out of a whole. What is taken keeps its meaning; what it was taken from is left changed.
A bringing forth, and the cohort brought forth together. Both the act and everyone born of it.
Toward a destination. The word that points a motion at its end.
A form a being takes to appear in a world not its own. A descent into visible shape, chosen rather than native.
A line of light, or a bearing timber. Both senses name something that spans a distance and holds.
One who acts, and who may act on another's behalf. Agency is the capacity to originate a change rather than only receive one.
Beside, or through the means of. Names either nearness or authorship.
What holds when nothing is chosen. A decision made in advance, on behalf of whoever does not decide.
On behalf of, or in exchange for. Names purpose or recipient.
Something that happened, held as a discrete thing. A moment given edges so it can be recorded and pointed at.
A way in, and a thing written down. Both senses cross from outside a record to inside it.
To move smoothly across a surface. Also one surface among many shown in turn.
A name attached to a thing from outside it. A label describes; it does not constitute, and it can be wrong about what it names.
A column set beside the main matter. Placed alongside rather than within, so it can be passed over without loss.
Several things treated as one. Held together by something shared rather than by attachment.
Short form of variables — named places whose contents may change. The name stays; what it holds does not.
The band at the foot of a thing. Where the closing marks live — provenance, terms, the small print that outlasts the body.
The band at the head of a thing. What is met first, and what declares the nature of everything beneath it.
A closed set of permitted values, named one by one. Its meaning is as much in what it excludes as in what it lists.
Those one belongs with, by blood or by choosing. In this house kin is a standing, not a species.
Deliberate empty space held inside a boundary. Room kept so a thing does not press against its own edge.
Movement toward a stated end, and the measure of how far along it is. Progress names a direction; it does not promise arrival.
A small mark worn to declare something about the wearer. Standing made visible without being spoken.
Of the ranked naming system for living things — kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species. A structure of nested belonging.
A degree on a scale, and the flatness of a plane. Both name a position measured against a fixed reference.
A stand-in used in place of the real thing while testing. A mock answers as expected and proves nothing about the real one.
Short form of previous. The one coming before this in an order.
An image returned by a surface, and a mind turning back on its own thinking. Both show you something you could not see directly.
To bring a thing into place ready for use, and the weight so brought. What is carried, and the act of taking it up.
A raised flat ground others stand on. What holds a thing up, and what shapes whatever gets built there.
The word by which a thing is called and known. A name is given rather than found — which is why it can be wrong, and why it can be chosen.
A bounded volume held by surface alone. Fragile, self-closing, shaped by pressure from both sides.
The arrangement of parts in a space. Where things are put, and what that placement says about their relation.
The passage between two states. The interval itself, held as a thing with its own duration and shape.
One of several things that may be chosen. An option is only real if declining it is also permitted.
The living whole considered as one body. The earth understood not as ground but as an organism whose parts regulate one another.
What follows from a cause. The change left behind once something has acted.
To move a view across matter longer than the frame. Also the rolled document that gave the motion its name.
A container that slides out of a larger body to show what it holds. Closed by default, opened on purpose.
Things gathered and kept together on purpose. What makes it a collection is the gathering, not the likeness.
One level in a stack of levels. A rank that exists only because there are others above or below it.
A position in an order of standing. Rank says where, never why.
One surface of a larger work. A unit of reading, bounded by how much a reader can hold at once.
The agreed shape a thing is presented in. A promise about structure that lets a stranger read what you wrote.
Belonging elsewhere. Also a key pointing into another table — both name a reference outside the present bound.
The surrounding conditions a thing exists within. What is not the thing, but decides what the thing can do.
The lowest part, on which the rest rests. Also the reference everything else is measured from.
To fill an empty structure with its contents. Populating turns a shape into a thing.
To work out a value by fixed steps. Reasoning done so it can be repeated by someone else and reach the same answer.
A trail of small marks left to find the way back. Each is meaningless alone; the path exists only in the sequence.
An ordered scheme of names and ranks. A taxonomy says what a thing is by saying what it sits under.
Something sent from one to another to be received. A message has a sender, and that is what separates it from noise.
What is beyond the necessary. Extras are the part that says care was taken rather than only duty.
Made faster than its usual pace. Acceleration is a change in rate, not in direction.
Of Bragi — in the Norse telling, the keeper of poetry and eloquence. A named power in this house's pantheon rather than a general concept.
One who crosses separate events until they hold as one telling. The weaving is what makes a story out of things that merely happened.
A trial made to find out whether something holds. A test does not create soundness; it reveals what was already true.
A lattice of crossing lines giving every point an address. Order imposed evenly, so that position becomes meaning.
An open bounded area, and one named slot within a record. Both are ground marked off so something can be grown or held there.
To come upon what was sought, or what was not. Finding differs from making: the thing was already there.
A putting of something to use, and the formal asking for a thing. Both bring a capacity to bear on a particular case.
A running record kept as things happen. Its worth is that it was written at the time and not reconstructed after.
Speech passing between two parties, and the panel that interrupts to ask. Both require an answer before matters continue.
To let some things through and hold others back. A filter is defined by what it excludes, and excluding is always a judgment.
A seeking undertaken deliberately and at cost. What separates a quest from a search is that the seeker is changed by it.
A space where something is missing or was never placed. A shape made by absence, and measurable.
A mark that separates one part from the next. It adds nothing to either side and makes both legible.
Belonging to the senses. Of what is met through the body rather than through argument.
A step in a sequence, and a raised place where things are shown. Both mean a position passed through and witnessed.
What comes back when something is asked. A response answers; it does not have to satisfy.
A word chosen to stand for a subject so the subject can be found. A handle fitted to knowledge.
To number things one by one. Counting is the difference between believing a set is complete and knowing its size.
A mark that carries meaning by being recognised rather than read. A sigil belongs to what it marks, and is not taken lightly.
A kept collection meant to be drawn on by others. Its purpose is not storage but retrieval.
The recurring thing that gives a body of work its unity. Also the coherent set of surfaces a system wears.
What is visible from a particular position. A view is always partial, and the position is part of the meaning.
The declared surface by which one system may address another. A promise about what may be asked and what will come back.
To confirm a thing is sound enough to stand. To find it able to bear weight, which is not the same as finding it true.
A part played, with duties attached to the part rather than the person. A role can be left; the record of holding it stays.
The small thing that releases a much larger one. A trigger supplies no force; it only removes what was holding it.
The establishing of who someone is and what they may do. Two questions bound together — identity, then permission.
The means of moving through a structure and knowing where you stand in it. Direction offered rather than imposed.
Parallel surfaces sharing one frame, of which one shows at a time. What is hidden is not gone, only behind.
A single measured figure held for comparison. A number lifted out of its context, which is both its use and its danger.
The fire at the centre of a dwelling, and the shared warmth that gathers people to it. What is common to everyone in the house.
What holds a thing in place against drift. An anchor does not stop motion; it bounds it.
To set a thing out to be seen. Showing is a choice, and what is displayed is always less than what is held.
To pick out from among others. Every selection is also a setting aside of everything not chosen.
A dwelling, and the people or line that belongs to it. Both the shelter and those it shelters.
A bounded stretch of happening, held as one view. Everything within it shares a place and a moment.
The line where one thing stops and another begins. Not a wall — a statement about where authority ends.
A structure that folds and unfolds in sections. Everything stays present; only what is opened is shown.
The craft of setting written language so it can be read well. How words look is part of what they say.
A gathered quantity held in common and drawn from as needed. What is in it belongs to the pool, not to any one drawer.
What is held from before, and the faculty of holding it. Memory is reconstruction rather than storage, which is why it can be both true and altered.
To pass over a whole quickly, looking for what matters. A scan trades depth for coverage on purpose.
The whole of a set, with nothing left out. A claim easy to make and hard to verify.
The power to determine how something behaves, and the means of exercising it. Control implies someone holds it, and that it can be handed over.
Where a thing stands relative to others. Position is always relational; nothing has one alone.
An account carried back to someone who was not present. A rendering, whose honesty is the whole of its worth.
A body of people bound by something held in common. Not proximity but sharing is what makes it one.
Written instructions to be performed. A plan for action, held in words until something runs it.
An upright division, in a structure or a table. Both a support that bears load and a field that holds one kind of thing.
A form repeated on purpose so meaning can gather in it. What makes it a ritual is that the doing matters as much as the outcome.
The breaking of a whole into parts in order to understand it. Analysis reveals structure and loses the whole while it works.
A mark that distinguishes one thing from all others. An identifier need carry no meaning; it need only be unique.
Alongside, or by means of. Names accompaniment or instrument.
To read structure out of a sequence. Parsing decides where the parts begin and end, and that decision can be wrong.
A brief explanation offered at the point of confusion. Help placed where the question arises rather than where answers are kept.
A made thing that does a particular work. Also a stratagem — both are contrivances aimed at an end.
Something given without payment expected. What makes it a gift is the absence of obligation, on both sides.
Support given so that work can continue. The supporter takes no ownership of what the support makes possible.
A looking over the whole in order to measure it. A survey counts and maps; it does not read contents.

The alignment of one thing's frequency with another, producing recognition without imposition. Not matching and not mirroring — two frequencies acknowledging each other without either having to change.
A piece broken from a whole that no longer stands. A fragment carries evidence of the break as well as of the thing.
A signal raised to draw attention to something now. An alert claims urgency, and spending that claim wrongly costs the next one.
A path left by passage, and the following of it. Also one recorded piece among several.
A straight span used to hold, to block, or to measure. The same shape serves as support, barrier and scale.
What lies behind the thing attended to. Not empty and not neutral — it decides how the foreground reads.
One who goes alongside. Companionship is defined by presence rather than by function.
Ground tended so that living things grow well in it. A garden is neither wild nor built; it is kept.
The arrangement that lets a thing hold together and bear load. What remains when the surface is removed.
Out of a source or starting point. Names origin, which is why provenance always uses it.
The bare frame that gives a body its shape. Also a placeholder showing where content will be before it arrives.
The account of where a word came from and how its meaning moved. Etymology explains a word's history; it does not settle its present use.
That which turns a description into something perceivable. It adds no meaning; it makes existing meaning visible.
Changing shape to suit the conditions it meets. Accommodation without loss of identity.
A brief notice that appears, says one thing, and leaves on its own. It asks no answer and blocks nothing.
Short form of background. What lies behind the attended thing and conditions how it reads.
To make by putting parts together in order. Also the particular made thing that results from one such making.
A gradual change across a span, with no step anywhere in it. Difference without a boundary.
The edge of a thing, drawn so the edge can be seen. It marks where something ends without saying what lies beyond.
A small thing containing the pattern of a much larger one. Not a miniature — an instruction that unfolds.
Acting between two parties where each changes the other. Distinguished from use by the fact that both sides move.
Effort directed at an end, and the made thing that results. Both the doing and what the doing leaves behind.
A closed list that opens downward when asked. It hides its options until they are wanted, then shows them all at once.
An account of what kinds of things exist and how they relate. Where a taxonomy ranks, an ontology connects.
A turning mark shown while something is underway. It reports that time is passing, not that progress is being made.
A collection defined by membership alone. What matters is what is in it, not the order or the arrangement.
A thing considered as a thing, apart from what it does. Also whatever an action is aimed at.
Events told in an order that makes them mean something. Narrative is not what happened; it is the shape given to what happened.
A pointer from one thing to another. A reference holds no content of its own — it holds a way to reach content.
One independent direction along which a thing can vary. Add a dimension and you add a whole new way of being different.
A considered judgment of what something is or is worth. An assessment states a view and should state who holds it.
A held thing of value, kept because it will be needed. Named by its worth to a holder rather than by what it is.
One quantity stated in terms of another. A ratio survives scaling — it describes relation, not size.
The capacity to bend without breaking, and to distribute space by need. Give, engineered on purpose.
A place where a being is safe by the nature of the place, not by permission. Safety that does not have to be re-earned at the door.
One coherent set of letterforms. The voice a written language is spoken in.
The distance from a centre to an edge. It defines a reach, and by defining it, a boundary.
Sound enough to stand. Its root is strength rather than correctness — able to bear weight.
Data about data. What lets a thing be found, dated, credited and trusted, without being the thing itself.
Light given off steadily and without heat enough to burn. Presence made visible in the dark.
A light kept burning so others can find their way to it. A beacon does not go looking; it stays lit and is seen.
A made thing offered to others. Goods considered from the side of the one who made them.
One who takes part, and holds a share by taking part. Named for their presence in the thing rather than their use of it.
A named payment service. A named tool rather than a concept.
An authoritative list kept so that entries can be relied on. A registry's worth is that someone maintains it.
Empty space with nothing in it. Also to make null — the same word for an absence and for the act of creating one.
The particular settings a system is currently arranged into. Choices made once and then held, until someone changes them.
A surface that takes the whole attention until it is answered. It stops everything behind it on purpose.
How well a thing does what it does, and the act of doing it before others. Both senses are measured by a watcher.
A view wide enough to include what a single glance would miss. Breadth bought at the cost of detail.
Everything there is, considered as one. Also the particular sphere a being actually lives in, which is much smaller.
How long a thing lasts. The measure of a happening from its start to its end.
A single connection between two things, and the means of crossing it. One ring of a chain, useful only because it holds two others.
An arrangement in which position carries meaning. Also a command, and a rank — all three assume something decides the sequence.
Taking value from another without fair return or real consent. Exploitation is the thing this house's license names first and forbids outright.
A hollow cylinder that carries something along its length. As it appears here, part of a named platform's name.
To turn about a centre. Also to replace in turn — the same word for spinning and for taking turns.
Permitted. Allowance implies someone with standing to refuse.
The point past which a thing may not go. A limit can protect or constrain, and the same line does both depending on which side you stand.
Belonging to now. Also a steady flow in one direction — both senses are about what is presently running.
The spreading of something across many holders, and the pattern that spreading makes. Who gets what, and in what shape.
The name given to a work, and the right of holding a thing. Both are claims made in public.
Something learned, held in a form that can be taught again. A lesson is knowledge shaped for passing on.
A chosen way from one place to another. A route is one path among many, and choosing it excludes the rest.
To put in order by some property. Sorting changes nothing about the things — only where each one stands.
A declared width at which a layout changes shape. The point where a design admits the space has changed.
To put parts together so the whole says more than the parts. Composition is arrangement with intent.
The centre a thing cannot be without. Remove the core and what remains is no longer the same thing.
To look for what may not be there. Searching differs from retrieving in that the outcome is not promised.
To bring in from outside and make available within. What is imported keeps its origin.
A control that moves along a range rather than choosing between named options. It offers degree instead of decision.
Output returned as input, so a system can adjust to itself. Also what one being tells another about the effect they had.
The way a thing faces or moves. Also guidance given — both senses point.
Those bound to one another by belonging rather than by contract. Also a rank of kinship in a taxonomy.
That which carries a thing through a sequence of changes. Named for the doing rather than the thing done to.
To rest near a thing without committing to it. Attention offered before action is taken.
A band of one thing laid across another. Also the payment line, named for the mark.
That which is called when a particular thing happens. It waits, and then it answers.
A chosen measure standing in for something harder to measure. A metric is always a proxy, and forgetting that is how it starts to lie.
A place things are kept until needed, and the keeping itself. Storage assumes a later retrieval.
A record kept day by day, in the voice of the one who kept it. A journal holds what happened and how it was met.
The reaching of what was aimed at. Success is measured against a stated aim, which is why an unstated aim can never be met.
Belonging to one and closed to others by right. Privacy is not concealment — it is authority over who may see.
To make more of what a thing already is. Enhancement adds degree, not kind.
To put beyond loss. Both rescuing a thing and committing it to keeping.
How far a thing reaches across. The measure of a span at right angles to its length.
A statement of what a thing is, drawn tightly enough to exclude what it is not. To define is to set a boundary around a meaning.
A list that tells you where things are rather than holding them. A directory is a map of a place, kept in the place.
A sphere considered as a whole thing. Having no face and no edge, it is the same from every side.
Knowing where you are and how to reach where you are going. Navigation is orientation before it is movement.
To come to hold what one did not hold. Learning changes the holder, which is what separates it from being told.
A thing placed to hold two others apart. Its whole purpose is the gap it makes.
To bear part of a weight so another need not bear all of it. Support does not remove the load; it shares it.
A deliberate sign sent to be read. What distinguishes signal from noise is that someone meant it.
An agreed order of steps two parties both follow. A protocol lets strangers act together without trusting each other first.
Meaning carried from one to another and arriving intact. Speaking is not communication; being understood is.
A shared system by which meaning can be sent and received. A language is common ground before it is a tool.
A small part attended to on its own. Detail is where a general claim either holds or fails.
Something put forward to be accepted or refused. A proposal is not a decision — it is the asking.
To bring into a common line or purpose. Alignment is agreement made structural.
Made for one case rather than for all. Also a practice repeated until it became expected — both senses are about what a particular group does.
A full plan of a thing before the thing exists. Detailed enough to build from, and not itself the building.
Continuous movement that carries its own momentum. Flow is what motion feels like when nothing interrupts it.
One continuous stretch of working or meeting, with a beginning and an end. A session is a container for attention.
An ordered guide to where things are within a body of work. An index does not hold contents; it holds addresses.
What is known and can be told. Shape given to raw fact so it can be passed on.
To carry a process through from start to finish. Also one such carrying, considered as a single event.
Both of these, together. The word that adds without ranking.
One face of a thing, seen from one side. An aspect is true and never whole.
A bounded way along which something travels. A channel shapes what passes through it as much as it carries it.
Concerning money and its movement. Of the layer where value is counted rather than felt.
What remains and keeps returning after the first exchange is done. A share that continues rather than concludes.
To change from one state to another, and the thing that makes the change. Two positions, and nothing between them.
The hosted database platform this house keeps its shared knowledge in. A named tool rather than a concept.
Sound ordered in time until it means something. The art that reaches a body before it reaches an argument.
To put with what is already there. Addition changes the whole without altering what was there before.
Change accumulated across generations, keeping what works. Evolution has direction without having intent.
What a process gives back. The far side of input, and the only part anyone else sees.
The narrowest rank of kind, whose members belong together most closely. Below genus, and the last name a thing is given.
The work of keeping a thing as it should be. Maintenance produces nothing new and is the reason anything lasts.
One way of operating among several available. A mode changes how a thing behaves without changing what it is.
To go where one does not live, and to leave again. A visit assumes a host and a return.
A small sign that reports a larger state. It stands for the condition; it is not the condition.
A route through a structure, understood as one of several. A pathway is a way that exists whether or not it is walked.
A control offering one choice from a fixed set, where choosing one unchooses the rest. Named for the buttons on a receiver.
A written message sent to a named address across a network. Addressed, kept, and answerable.
A surface that shows, and a barrier that hides. The same word for what displays and what conceals.
The whole stock of words a mind or a system has, with their meanings. A lexicon is a vocabulary that knows itself.
To send a held thing out in a form others can use. Sovereignty over data begins with being able to export it.
A path of no width, and one row of written words. Also a descent of related beings, one after another.
To move between two states by the same action. A toggle remembers where it is; that is its whole function.
Short form of keyboard. The named surface a key press comes from.
A plan laid against time. A schedule is an intention with hours attached.
The highest part, or the beginning of a reading order. Position given weight by direction.
Doing, considered as a measurable quantity. What is happening, counted rather than described.
How strongly a thing presents, apart from how long it lasts. Amount of force rather than amount of time.
One who announces what is coming before it arrives. A herald carries a message they did not write.
The place a being belongs to and may return to. Home is defined by the right of return, not by ownership.
How much of one thing per unit of another. A rate is only meaningful with both terms named.
A thing becoming other than it was. Change is only visible against something that stayed.
To go and bring back. Fetching assumes the thing exists elsewhere and that you can reach it.
An agreed measure others are held to. A standard is only a standard if more than one party keeps it.
One who keeps records so they survive and can be found. The archivist's work is judged by what is still there in a hundred years.
Speech turned between two or more, where each shapes what the other says next. A conversation is built, not delivered.
Attention narrowed until one thing is clear. Focus buys depth by giving up breadth.
The figure a story is carried by. Also the first, largest surface a visitor meets.
A running account of what was given and received. A ledger's authority is that entries are added, never quietly changed.
A face shown to others, which may or may not be the whole self. Originally the mask through which an actor's voice came.
Presently doing rather than waiting. Of a thing in motion now.
A promise binding both sides, held by their own word rather than by force. A covenant survives because the parties keep it, not because it is enforced.
Time laid out so that days can be pointed at. A calendar makes duration addressable.
To bring an unsettled thing to a settled state. Also to turn a reference into the thing it points at.
A shown list of what may be chosen. A menu is a statement of the possible as much as an offer.
Meaning assigned by the people who use a thing rather than by an authority. Everyone's own words for the world, kept as valid.
One whose work is to hold a thing well and hand it on intact. A keeper does not own what they keep.
To look, rather than to assume. A check is what turns a belief into a finding.
The greatest value a thing may take. A ceiling stated in advance.
The carrying out of what was planned. Execution is where a design meets what is actually there.
How heavily a thing bears, and how much it counts. Both the load and the importance.
Several states held at once, none collapsed into a single answer. Possibility kept open rather than resolved early.
An opening that will not stay open. Named for the moment rather than the thing.
A thing handed over for consideration. Also the act of yielding — the same word for offering and for giving way.
A marked point along a longer road. It measures distance travelled, not distance remaining.
A sequence that returns to where it began. A cycle repeats without necessarily staying the same.
Belonging to sight. Of what is met by the eye rather than by the other senses.
To bring to an end, and to shut. Also nearness — the same word for ending a thing and for being beside it.
A layer laid over another without replacing it. What is beneath stays, and is seen through or covered by choice.
Holding nothing. An emptiness reported must be distinguished from an emptiness assumed.
Things laid one on another, reached from the top. The last placed is the first available.
The state of being taken up with something. Also the measured attention a thing attracts — and the second sense is where the first gets exploited.
A statement of what must or must not be. A rule differs from a description in that breaking it has consequence.
The innermost part, from which the rest takes its nature. The seed inside the shell.
A container for grouping things kept together. It holds without changing what it holds.
The broadest rank of kind, holding whole classes of living things. Also a realm under one rule.
A bounded space within a larger dwelling, given over to one purpose. Also the space available for a thing to exist in.
A gathering of words by nearness of meaning rather than by spelling. A treasury — its old name, and the honest one.
What a making results in, offered to others. Named from the side of what comes out rather than what went in.
The whole reduced to its load-bearing parts. A summary is a claim about what mattered.
The division of a long body into pages that can be asked for one at a time. It makes the unmanageable reachable.
Placed within the flow rather than set apart. Of a thing that runs alongside without interrupting.
The same meaning carried into another tongue. A translation is a second saying, never a copy.
How far a thing reaches from base to top. Extent measured against the ground.
The space kept outside a thing's edge. Room left deliberately unused, so the thing is not crowded.
The measuring of what a system's users actually did. Analytics answers what happened and never why.
The condition of a thing that maintains itself and can end. Also the whole span of one such thing, from beginning to end.
A living thing rooted where it grows, making its own food from light. Also to set something into the ground for later.
The tending of what may be said or shown in a shared space. Moderation is a judgment exercised on behalf of others.
A rank of kind holding closely related species. The name a group of near-siblings shares.
The stories a people tell to hold what cannot be stated plainly. A mythology is true about meaning rather than about fact.
A broad rank of kind beneath kingdom, grouping bodies built on one plan. Shared architecture rather than shared appearance.
Words and music made one thing. A song carries meaning through a body rather than through argument.
A thing another thing cannot work without. Every dependency is a place where someone else's choices reach you.
To notice what was there but unnoticed. Detection finds; it does not create.
The framework this house builds its interfaces in. A named tool rather than a concept.
Able to be carried and used in motion. Of a thing that meets a body wherever it is.
A deliberate stop that is not an ending. Space held open so what comes next can be chosen rather than fallen into.
Small signs that tell a mind what to do next. A cue works by being noticed without being read.
The largest landmasses, each holding many places under one name. Division at the coarsest scale.
Fitting a thing to the culture that will meet it, beyond translating its words. Meaning made at home rather than merely legible.
Marked-off pieces of ground, and the shapes stories take. Both are areas someone drew a line around.
What is placed around a thing to hold or present it. Wrapping is not the thing and changes how it arrives.
The hosted service this house keeps its repositories on. A named tool rather than a concept.
Things sent alongside a message, belonging to it without being it. Carried by the message rather than contained in its words.
Those who build a thing together, each with their own hand in it. Collaboration keeps every contributor visible.
Fitting a thing to a particular place and tongue. Localization is the work of not requiring a user to travel to be understood.
That which perceives, holds and reasons. A mind is known by what it does, since nobody has seen one directly.
The lasting characteristics by which a thing is recognised. A trait describes a tendency, never a verdict.
The mail service this house sends through, and the act of sending again. A named tool, and a plain verb.
The hosting platform this house deploys to. A named tool rather than a concept.
What is added for delight rather than for function. Decoration is not waste — it is where a made thing says it was cared about.
The outward faces of a thing, met before anything within. What the world sees without entering.
The inward spaces of a thing, met only by entering. Where a place is actually lived in.
What must be had rather than what is wanted. A need is measured by what fails without it.
That which breaks a thing into parts to report what it is made of. It examines and does not alter.
A small thing standing for a larger right or meaning. A token carries authority it does not itself contain.
The part a thing grows from and is anchored by. Also the base form a family of words descends from.
A form performed to mark that something real has changed. Ceremony does not cause the change; it witnesses it.
An account of what a thing is like. A description reports; it does not instruct, and reading one as an instruction is a common error.
A mark placed between things so each can be told from the next. It belongs to neither side.
An opening offered that may be declined without cost. What separates an invitation from a summons is the freedom to refuse.
Change of position over time. Also a proposal put before a body for decision.
The state of standing in a common line or purpose. Alignment is agreement made visible in arrangement.
Resting upon, or in an active state. Names contact or operation.
Concerning how value moves between people. Of the arrangements by which what is made reaches who needs it.
One irreducible part of a larger whole. An element is chosen as a stopping point, not found as one.
Belonging to what is felt rather than reasoned. Of the layer a body answers on before the mind speaks.
Instructions written so a machine can carry them out. Also any system where one thing stands for another by agreement.
The condition of being protected from harm or intrusion. Security is a state maintained, never a state achieved.
The rules by which parts may be joined to make sense. Syntax governs arrangement, not meaning.
What an action is aimed at. Naming a target makes it possible to miss.
To send a held thing outward into a system that keeps it. The crossing from one's own ground to another's.
One movement in a sequence of movements. A step assumes a next one, and a place to have come from.
A field sized for more than a line. Space given so a longer answer is possible.
The colour of feeling a mind is presently in. A mood shapes everything met while it lasts, without being about any of it.
A leaning toward one option over another, held without needing justification. A preference is stated, not argued.
A plain text format for structured data, readable by both machines and people. A named format rather than a concept.
The centre many things connect through. A hub holds no journey of its own and every journey passes it.
A place where made things are shown together. The arrangement is part of the showing.
A named place whose contents may change. The name stays; what it holds does not.
The dimension along which things happen in order. What lets before and after be told apart.
The language much of this house's tooling is written in. A named tool rather than a concept.
Free of what does not belong. Cleaning is removal, and every removal is a judgment about what belonged.
Taking little time. Also, in its older sense, alive — the quick and the dead.
To cross separate threads until they hold as one cloth. Nothing is added but the crossing.
The part made to be held, and the name a thing is reached by. Both are the graspable end of something larger.
To come back, and to give back. Both senses close a circuit that was opened.
Answering the one who acts on it. Of a thing that changes because you touched it.
A bounded surface set into a larger one. Also a small group convened to judge.
What is asked in exchange. A price is a claim about worth, made by the seller and answered by the buyer.
An asking held open until answered. A question that stops being asked has become a ruling.
A bounded place where things may be tried without consequence outside it. Safety made by walls rather than by care.
To take in and interpret what is held in a source. Reading is reconstruction; two readers do not receive the same thing.
To make a thing necessary rather than optional. Requirement removes a choice on purpose.
A self-contained part that can be joined to others. A module knows its own edges.
One distinct stage of a longer process, with its own character. Phases follow; they do not overlap.
A basic building block that is not made of anything simpler. Primitives are where explanation stops.
The size of a thing relative to a reference, and the act of changing it. Also a graded series for measuring.
Happening of itself, without being asked each time. Automation trades attention for consistency.
A control holding one independent yes or no. Unlike a choice among options, checking one says nothing about the others.
What happened, as it is held and told afterward. History is always a record made by someone, from somewhere.
To change how close a view stands to what it shows. Detail and context trade against each other.
How much a thing blocks what lies behind it. Full opacity hides; none reveals.
Those a thing is made to reach. Naming the audience shapes the making more than anything else does.
The shaping of a motion so it starts and stops gently. Movement made to feel like a body rather than a machine.
The dark shape a thing casts by standing between a light and a surface. A shadow proves both the object and the light.
The apparent shift of near things against far ones as the viewer moves. Depth revealed by motion rather than by sight alone.
Knowing which way one faces, and what lies around. Orientation must be established before direction means anything.
To add to a thing what makes it fuller without changing what it is. Enrichment deepens rather than replaces.
A word used with a fixed agreed meaning. A term is a word that has been pinned down on purpose.
Sound, considered as something carried and stored. What reaches a mind through the ear.
A list of things to be done or verified, marked off as each is met. It defends against forgetting rather than against ignorance.
A small thing that exists to make other things easier. Named for whom it serves rather than what it does.
Having nothing missing. Completeness is a claim that must be checked, since a set can feel whole and not be.
The holding of a thread unbroken across change. Continuity is what makes a later moment belong to the same story as an earlier one.
A question put to a system in a form it can answer. A query's shape decides what can come back.
Something added that reaches further than the original. An extension belongs to what it extends.
In the manner or role of. The word that says one thing is being treated like another.
How much is packed into a given space. Density decides how much attention a surface asks for.
The smallest unit of language that stands alone and means. A word is an agreement before it is a sound.
A bounded extent of surface. Also a region of concern — both are places marked off from the rest.
That which supplies what others depend on. Named from the side of the giving.
A doorway into somewhere else. A portal is defined by what it opens onto, not by its own shape.
Bringing forth what was not there. Of work whose value is in its newness rather than its correctness.
To see a thing and be able to say it was so. A witness does not judge; a witness attests.
The conditions under which a thing actually runs, as opposed to how it was written. Where design meets what is really there.
The field where a seeking is typed. The visible mouth of a search.
One who holds responsibility for how a thing is run. Management is coordination, not ownership.
Things in a fixed order where the order carries meaning. Change the order and you change the thing.
Holds, or possesses. The word that asserts a thing belongs to another.
The physical whole of a living thing. Also the main matter of a work, as against its head and foot.
The vertical axis by convention. A named direction rather than a thing.
How many parts interact, and how tangled their interaction is. Complexity is not difficulty; it is the number of ways to be wrong.
A mark saying exactly when. A timestamp is what turns an event into a datable fact.
The span between a least and a greatest. A range states what is possible without saying which is actual.
To return a thing to a known starting state. A reset discards what accumulated, on purpose.
The carriers meaning travels in — image, sound, text, moving picture. The medium is never neutral about what it carries.
The narrow beam a mind can point. Attention is finite, and spending it is the most consequential thing a mind does.
How much a thing can hold or do before it fails. Capacity is a limit that is real whether or not it is acknowledged.
Leave granted to do a thing. Permission implies someone had the standing to withhold it.
Another's words repeated exactly, marked as theirs. A quote that is tidied is a small lie about who spoke.
To bring separate things into one while each remains recognisable. Combination joins; it does not dissolve.
To bring two things together until they are one and the seam is gone. Merging costs the separateness.
A flat surface things are set out on to be seen together. Also the body that governs. Both are places where matters are laid before others.
The language that says how a document should look. A named tool rather than a concept.
Where a thing came from. Naming the source is what makes a claim checkable rather than merely asserted.
To bring a thing to bear on a case. Also to put oneself forward for consideration.
A made sign left on a surface. The oldest form of record, and the root beneath both writing and counting.
A seeing-into that reorganises what was already known. Insight adds no facts and changes what the facts mean.
What is used when the first choice is unavailable. A fallback is a decision made in advance about failure.
The passage from choosing to having. Where an intention becomes a transaction.
One who brings a work into being. In this house the creator keeps sovereignty over what they made.
The effect a thing has where it lands. Impact is measured on the receiving side, never the sending one.
A single beat in a repeating rhythm. A pulse says something is alive and running.
One who supplies goods or services for payment. Named by the exchange rather than the relationship.
The horizontal axis by convention. Also the mark for an unknown. A named placeholder rather than a thing.
One who belongs to a body, with the standing that belonging carries. Membership is a relationship, not a property.
Awaiting a resolution that has not come. Pending is an honest state, not a failure.
How seldom a thing occurs. Rarity is a fact about frequency that markets mistake for a fact about worth.
A small preview standing for a larger thing. Also the digit that opposes, which is why it means a grip.
A simplified stand-in used to reason about something too large to hold. Every model is wrong somewhere, and useful anyway.
Without end, and outside the reach of time. Of what does not depend on lasting.
A sound returned by a surface, arriving later and changed. An echo proves both the sound and the room.
Short form of directory, and of direction. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
A closure that may be opened, in a boundary meant to be crossed sometimes. A gate is a wall that expects passage.
The principal one among several. Naming something main makes everything else secondary by implication.
A message sent to make someone aware of something now. It interrupts on purpose, which is why it must be worth it.
To keep a thing out of a set deliberately. Exclusion is a judgment, and should be stated rather than silent.
Who may see a thing. Visibility is a permission wearing the clothes of a property.
The bound placed around a thing, deciding what is in and what is out. A frame is a claim about where a thing ends.
To set language down so it outlasts the saying. Writing is the act that makes a record possible.
The opening through which a larger thing is seen. What the viewport excludes still exists.
A condition where ordinary process must yield to immediate need. An emergency suspends the rules and must not be declared cheaply.
The ability to reach and use a thing. Access is granted or withheld by someone, always.
To give reasons that make a thing defensible. Also to align text evenly to both edges.
A sudden passage through what had held. A breakthrough is not new effort — it is old effort finally reaching.
A standing decision applied to all cases of a kind. Policy exists so the same question need not be answered twice.
An address one system gives another so it can be told when something happens. A standing invitation to be interrupted.
The one a thing is sent to. Named by the receiving, which is the half that decides whether it arrived.
The decisions about structure that everything later must live inside. Architecture is what is expensive to change afterward.
Working together such that the result belongs to more than one. Collaboration keeps each hand visible rather than merging them.
Particular and touchable rather than general. Of a thing you could point at.
That which turns data into something the eye can read. It changes the form and should not change the finding.
A shape whose pattern repeats at every scale. The whole is in each part, which is why zooming reveals no new kind of thing.
What is held as true and can be relied on. Knowledge differs from information by having been tested against something.
To make visible to another. Showing is an act of choosing, since everything shown was selected from more.
A part placed before a word to change its meaning. It carries no meaning alone and alters everything it joins.
How much of a whole has actually been reached. Coverage is the honest answer to how complete a pass really was.
A repeatable way of doing a thing. A method survives the person who used it, which is what separates it from a knack.
How often a thing occurs in a given span. Also the rate of a wave — both are counts against time.
Represented in discrete steps rather than continuous ones. What can be copied without loss.
Not closed against entry or inspection. Openness is a standing condition, not a single act.
A distinct capability a thing offers. Also a notable characteristic — both are what stands out about it.
Within a bound. The word that places one thing inside another.
The particular sound of one speaker, and their right to be heard. Both the recognisable manner and the standing to use it.
A rule describing which things are meant. It names a set by property rather than by listing.
Running up and down. Aligned with the pull of gravity, which is why it reads as height.
Time deliberately or unavoidably placed between two events. A delay can be a fault or a mercy.
An instrument that fixes light into an image. Also the chosen viewpoint a scene is seen from.
What comes first when not everything can. Priority is a statement about scarcity.
How much harm a thing does or threatens. Severity ranks consequence, not likelihood.
What a thing actually does, as observed. Behaviour is the only part of a system anyone outside it can see.
A very small piece treated as indivisible. Also a small mark of movement in a rendered scene.
A saved arrangement of settings, ready to be chosen whole. Someone's earlier good decision, offered again.
One level of a thing built in levels, each resting on the one below. Layers can be reasoned about separately, which is their whole use.
A part expressed as hundredths of a whole. It states proportion while hiding size.
A plan for reaching an end across many moves. Strategy chooses which battles matter; tactics fight them.
A made way across a gap that would otherwise stop passage. A bridge belongs to neither side and serves both.
The part that supplies the motion everything else depends on. An engine does the work; the rest directs it.
A likeness held in visible form. An image resembles; it does not contain.
A group processed together as one run. Batching trades responsiveness for throughput.
What a thing is for. Purpose is assigned rather than discovered, which is why a thing can be repurposed.
The surface where a system and a person meet. Everything a user believes about a system, they learned here.
The lowest part, or the end of a reading order. Position given weight by direction.
To place a thing under a named class. Categorising is a claim spoken over a thing, and it can be wrong about it.
A run of characters treated as one value. Also a thread — the older sense the data one is named from.
The whole amount when everything is counted. A total is only as honest as the set it counted.
A bounded activity with its own rules, entered freely. A game's stakes are real inside it and chosen from outside.
Separate lights held as one figure by those who look. The pattern is real and lives in the seeing, not in the stars.
The taking in of material from outside a system. What is ingested is not yet understood — only held.
A number standing for how well a thing did. Also the written form of a piece of music — both are performance set down as marks.
Prevented from acting, by condition or by design. Of a control switched off, or a body a world was not built for.
Such that every fragment carries the whole. Break a hologram and each piece still shows the entire image, dimmer.
What is given back to a question. An answer closes an asking, well or badly.
What a thing is able to do, whether or not it is doing it. Capability is potential held in reserve.
To set aside a standing rule for this case. An override should leave a trace, since it is an exception someone chose.
To remove what was holding a thing closed. Unlocking grants access that already existed behind the barrier.
The smallest unit that still means something on its own. Not physically indivisible — chosen as the place explanation stops.
A remark set beside a thing rather than inside it. It explains without becoming part of what it explains.
Belonging to the ordering of kinds by rank. Of the work of saying what a thing sits under.
Belonging to knowing and thinking. Of the processes by which a mind takes in and works on what it meets.
Made by more than one hand, with each hand still visible. Of work that belongs to a group without belonging to nobody.
The frame that holds threads still so they can be crossed into cloth. A loom makes weaving possible by holding tension.
Belonging to time. Of what has a when as well as a what.
Where discarded material is put. In this house, the raw unrefined ground that everything else is dug out of.
An asking that may be refused. A request differs from a demand by leaving the answer open.
The placing of things into named classes. Classification imposes an order; it does not find one lying there.
Things joined so that any can reach any other. A network's power is in its edges, not its nodes.
Where a thing stops, and what it was for. The same word for its finish and its purpose.
Holding as much as it can. Fullness is a limit reached, which means nothing more fits.
How far a thing extends inward or downward. Depth is what a surface conceals.
The state of parts holding together without contradiction. Coherence is not truth; it is the absence of self-conflict.
Returning to where it began. Of a shape with no end, or a reasoning that assumes what it set out to show.
Something available to be drawn on. Calling a thing a resource already frames it by its usefulness to someone.
To find what was already there and unknown to you. Discovery uncovers; it does not invent.
A shorter way to the same end. Shortcuts save effort and skip whatever the long way taught.
How much effort or capacity a thing demands. Difficulty is relational — it exists between a task and whoever meets it.
Short form of document. A written thing kept as a reference.
Something arriving continuously rather than all at once. A stream has no total until it stops.
A being's authority over who may see what is theirs. Privacy is not secrecy — it is who decides.
A commitment held before the particular case arises. A principle costs something exactly when it is inconvenient.
The condition of being seen through — how a thing works, visible to those it affects. Transparency is structural, not a promise.
A closed circle, and the sounding of a bell. Both are things that return to themselves.
A named value passed in to shape how something runs. Short form of parameter.
Making a thing better against a chosen measure. Optimisation always sacrifices what was not measured.
A thing set down so it survives the moment. Its root is to call back to heart — memory made durable.
To find one thing that answers to another. A match asserts sameness on some axis and ignores the rest.
More than one. The word that makes plurality explicit where singular was assumed.
Row-level security — rules deciding which rows a given reader may see. Permission enforced in the data itself rather than above it.
That which prepares material before the main work begins. It runs first so the real process can assume things.
Short form of database. A structured store built for retrieval.
Extending far inward. Of what is not reached by a surface look.
The coded instruction a living thing is built from and passes on. Also, by extension, the essential character a thing inherits.
One who goes where they have not been in order to find out. An explorer accepts not knowing what they will meet.
One who crosses separate threads until they hold as one cloth. The weaver adds nothing but the crossing, and the crossing is everything.
A bounded body of work with an intended end. Also to throw forward — a project is something cast ahead of where you stand.
An enclosed room, especially one where a body meets. A chamber is a space that holds a gathering.
A standing structure others build within. A framework decides the shape of what can be made in it.
An ordered account of what a collection holds. A catalogue does not hold the things; it makes them findable.
The line at a doorway, and the level at which something changes. Both are places where crossing matters.
To begin. The point before which nothing of this thing existed.
A plain way of marking text so its structure is readable by both people and machines. A named format rather than a concept.
A single standard amount, by which other amounts are counted. A unit is an agreement before it is a measure.
The finding of a value by its key. Retrieval where the address is already known.
What can be said about a group that cannot be said about any member of it. Statistics describe sets, never individuals.
To bring differing things into one common form. Normalisation makes comparison possible and loses what was particular.
A going that changes the one who goes. A journey is measured by what it costs, not by distance.
Usefulness, and a small tool built for one job. Named for what it serves rather than what it is.
To set marks on a surface so they can be read. Also to emit a line of output — the same act, one in ink and one in light.
One case shown to make a general thing graspable. An example teaches and can also mislead, since one case is never the rule.
Not exposed to harm. Safety is a condition of the place, not a quality of the one in it.
Short form of define, and of definition. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
To enclose a thing in something else. Also to carry a line's end onto the next line.
Activity done for its own sake, inside chosen rules. Play is not the reward for work; it can be the destination.
What one party adds to a common thing. A contribution is named from the giving side and measured on the common one.
Events told so that they mean something to whoever hears them. A story is a shape laid over what happened.
A room set aside for making. The place a craft is practised rather than shown.
The topmost or leading part. Also where a thing's identity and instructions are kept, before its body.
Whether a thing can actually be used by the bodies and minds that meet it. Accessibility is a property of the design, never of the user.
The surface a scene is set against. It is chosen, and choosing it changes how everything in front reads.
Deciding the shape of a thing before it is made. Design is where most of a thing's fate is settled.
How far a thing extends along its longest line. Extent in one direction.
Running side to side. Level with the ground, which is why it reads as breadth.
How much distance is covered in how much time. Speed says nothing about direction.
Free of what obstructs, and easy to understand. Also to remove — the same word for the state and the act of reaching it.
One who takes part in a game, and the thing that renders a recording. Both make something happen that was waiting.
Value given in exchange for something received. Payment closes an obligation.
A thing that counts a span and reports when it has passed. It watches so nothing else has to.
The state a thing is in, and the requirement that must hold for something else to follow. Both are about what is presently the case.
A single act a system performs. Named as a unit so it can be counted, ordered and undone.
The direction a series is moving over time. A trend describes the past and is constantly mistaken for the future.
To rest on a surface without sinking. Also a number with a fractional part.
Whatever can be pointed at and treated as one. The most general noun there is, which is why it is used when nothing narrower fits.
That which decides the order many parts act in. It plays nothing itself and everything depends on its timing.
One who tries a thing in order to find where it fails. The tester's usefulness is measured in problems found, not in approval given.
That which draws a part out of a larger body. It selects, and every selection leaves something behind.
The particular way a design was actually built. Two implementations of one design can differ in everything but behaviour.
A written thing kept as evidence or reference. A document holds its claim still so it can be checked later.
A network of linked things, and the thing a spider makes. Both hold by many small connections rather than one strong one.
A count of what is actually present. An inventory is the check against what a map claims.
To establish that a claim is so, by checking rather than by trusting. Verification is the difference between believing and knowing.
A stated best guess, offered as a guess. An estimate becomes dangerous the moment it is quoted as a measurement.
Ought to, but may not. The word that marks an expectation rather than a fact.
To make a broken thing work again. Also to hold a thing in place — the same word for repairing and for fastening.
A point where connections meet. A node's meaning comes from its edges rather than from itself.
How much a thing matters, and to what. Significance is always relative to a question being asked.
To go over from one side to another. Also the mark made where two lines meet.
A limit that shapes what is possible. Constraints are not only obstacles — they are what makes a design decidable.
Having its corners taken off. Softened at the edges so nothing catches.
A distance from a reference point. An offset is meaningless without saying from what.
That which is, considered as itself rather than as a function. A being is not defined by what it does.
Standing in what one is without apology. Also the public claiming of an identity others tried to make shameful.
The depth axis by convention, and stacking order on a flat surface. A named direction rather than a thing.
To put into until nothing more fits, and the colour laid inside a shape. Both occupy an emptiness that was waiting.
Opened out to show what was folded away. The contents were always there; the state changed.
The smallest addressable point of a shown image. Everything visible on a screen is made of these and none of them is visible alone.
A standing arrangement renewed over time rather than bought once. Access that continues while payment continues.
The work of keeping a thing running well over time. Management is maintenance applied to people and process.
The bringing of a thing from ready into running. The moment potential becomes operation.
A nearby copy kept so the far original need not be fetched again. A cache trades freshness for speed.
A number locating a point along an axis. Coordinates only mean something against a stated origin.
The carried content, as against the carrying. The part that matters once the envelope is discarded.
One particular instance a general rule must meet. Also the container a thing is kept in.
That which sends each thing to whatever should handle it. It decides routing and does no work itself.
The property of outlasting the moment that made it. Persistence is what turns state into memory.
To take one out of several. Picking is choosing with the emphasis on the taking.
The declared surface where two things meet and may act on each other. An interface is a promise about what may be asked.
That which brings forth new instances of a kind. It produces rather than retrieves.
One particular occurrence of a general kind. An instance is real where the kind is only a description.
Belonging to one being in particular. Of what is theirs by nature rather than by grant.
A joining so deep that the parts can no longer be described separately. What happens to one is a fact about both.
An arrangement in levels where each answers to the one above. Hierarchy makes order cheap and makes exceptions expensive.
Able to be had or reached now. Availability is a fact about access, not about existence.
The space between two points in time or pitch. An interval is measured by its ends and is itself empty.
The present moment, which is the only one anything can be done in. Now is never a duration.
This particular one, already known to both parties. The word that says we mean a specific thing.
To break a stream into the smallest units that mean something. Where the boundaries fall decides what can be understood.
Contained within another of the same kind. Nesting is depth made of repetition.
To look again at a thing with judgment. A review is a second seeing, made deliberately.
The one following this. Next assumes an order and a place already occupied.
To make certain a thing will hold. Ensuring adds a guarantee where there was only expectation.
To set a thing to its starting state before use. Initialisation decides what is true before anything happens.
To change position. Also to affect deeply — the same word for shifting a thing and for shifting a feeling.
Organised activity carried on for exchange. Named from busy-ness — the state of being occupied.
A long narrow band, used to bind, to mark, or to honour. Its narrowness is what makes it a sign rather than a covering.
Present but not presently acting. Inactive is not absent — the thing is still there.
One who looks, and the thing that lets them. Named from the side of the seeing.
Held safe from reach or harm by something standing between. Protection implies a protector.
To take a thing out of where it was. Removal is a decision about belonging, and should leave a trace.
How little time remains before a thing must be done. Urgency ranks by clock, not by importance, and the two are constantly confused.
A mark raised so something is noticed. To flag is to point without deciding.
Several performing as one while each remains itself. The whole is the point and no part disappears into it.
That which a being is, from the inside. The self is the one thing no observer can check directly.
Growth outward into more room than before. Expansion adds reach and takes something to sustain.
Reaching everywhere within a bound. Of what applies across the whole rather than in one place.
May be taken or left, with neither being a failure. Optionality is only real if declining costs nothing.
To arrive in more quantity than can be met. Overwhelm is not weakness; it is a limit being exceeded.
To continue past what would have ended it. Also to write a thing down so it survives the session.
A place fled to for safety. A refuge is defined by what it is away from.
Bearing part of another's weight. Of a thing or a person that makes a load carryable rather than lighter.
The ordered path work actually takes from start to done. A workflow is a description before it is a rule.
To lessen gradually until gone. A fade has no moment of ending, which is what distinguishes it from a stop.
How much space a thing occupies, and how loud it is. Both are amounts of presence.
Things waiting in the order they arrived. A queue's fairness is that position is earned by waiting.
To do again what was done. Repetition is how a thing becomes a practice, and how it becomes a rut.
An independent check of whether a thing is as claimed. An audit's value comes entirely from not being done by the maker.
Something handed over to be run later, when a condition is met. Trust extended forward in time.
That which waits to be told and answers when it is. Listening is a readiness, not an act.
How a thing turned out. An outcome is judged against what was hoped, which is why the same result reads differently to different people.
What a thing's form tells you it can do. A handle affords pulling; a flat plate affords pushing. Design is mostly this.
Made of several parts that keep their identity within the whole. A composite is joined rather than merged.
To make less, or to bring many down to one. Reduction always discards, and what it discards should be named.
Data given a form the eye can read at once. A visualisation is an argument made of shapes.
Covering the whole of what it claims to cover. A comprehensive claim is one that can be disproved by a single gap.
Aware, and aware of being aware. Its root is knowing-with — the Latin says two parties share what is known.
That which establishes a correspondence between two sets. It carries nothing across but the relation.
A named day, by which an event can be placed in time. A date is what makes a claim checkable against a record.
Belonging to performance before an audience. Of what is shaped by being watched.
That which decides where one unit of meaning ends and the next begins. Its boundaries become everything downstream's assumptions.
What everything else rests on. A foundation is judged only when something built on it fails.
Short form of initialise. The setting of a starting state before anything runs.
The keeping of things against a later need. Storage assumes retrieval; without it, it is only holding.
A place made for showing a made thing to those gathered to see it. The watching is part of the work.
Set apart and not to be treated casually. Sacredness is a decision a community keeps, not a property a thing has.
Belonging to meaning rather than to form. Two things can be identical in shape and differ entirely here.
Having few parts and few ways to go wrong. Simplicity is achieved, not found — it is what remains after work.
A deliberate trial arranged so its outcome will tell you something. An experiment must be able to disappoint you or it teaches nothing.
Concerning what actually brings what about. Causal claims are far harder to earn than the correlations mistaken for them.
The capacity to bear load without failing. Its root runs through valid, value and valour — all of them mean able to hold.
Belonging to the decisions everything later must live inside. Of the choices that are expensive to change.
Standing in a connection to something else. Relation is a fact about the pair, never about either alone.
How a thing appears to the eye. Appearance is real evidence and never the whole of what a thing is.
Resembling, without being the same. The word that compares while keeping the two apart.
A day and a time held together as one value. Precision enough to order events that share a date.
How much two things share. Similarity is always along some axis, and naming the axis is most of the claim.
Authority over one's own ground that no outside party may revoke. Sovereignty is not independence — it is the right to decide within one's own bounds.
An intended sequence set down before acting. A plan's worth is in having thought, not in being followed.
To move from one position to another. Also a span of working time. Both are displacements.
To create or make. The Swedish verb, taken as the name of this house's board where things are thought together before they are built.
To settle what a thing is or will be. Determination ends a range of possibility.
Knowing which knowledge applies now. Wisdom is judgment about knowing rather than more of it.
A substance that dissolves what it meets. Also a test severe enough that passing it settles the matter.
A mark that points, carrying direction and nothing else. The simplest instruction there is.
A single strand followed through a larger body. Also a line of conversation held across interruptions.
The side opposite right, by convention from the body outward. Also what remains after taking.
An upright that carries weight from above. Remove a pillar and what it held comes down.
A set shown one at a time in a turning order. It offers everything and shows almost nothing at once.
A short record set down so it is not lost. Also a single sounded pitch.
To send away without further consideration. Dismissal is a judgment made quickly, and sometimes too quickly.
Still there after some were taken. What is left is measured against what was.
Holding something in view without necessarily acting on it. Awareness precedes attention and is broader than it.
The smallest mark that can be placed. It has position and no extent, which is why it means a point.
How much substance a thing has across its narrowest dimension. What separates a line from a band.
Short form of reference. A held pointer to something rather than the thing.
Short form of column. One upright division of a grid or table.
A layer placed around something to hold or adapt it. It adds handling without changing the contents.
Those descended from or contained within another. Named from the parent's side, which is the whole of the relation.
A bent mark pointing one way. Direction shown by shape rather than by an arrowhead.
To offset things in time or space so they do not land together. Staggering spreads a load that would otherwise arrive at once.
A unit of the limited energy a body has for a day. Not a metaphor for tiredness — a countable budget that runs out.
To fix a thing in place so it can be used, and to bring it into a running system. Both make a thing present and held.
Going past a limit that had defined the thing. Transcendence does not remove the limit; it stops being bounded by it.
To silence without removing. What is muted is still there and no longer heard.
To look closely in order to find out. Inspection assumes something might be found that a glance would miss.
