To bring a thing back to a state it held before. Restoration returns the form and never the interval.
A bound set of works meant to be met together. The ordering is part of the making.
The chain by which one thing came from another. A derivation is what makes a result checkable rather than merely asserted.
Belonging to touch. Of what a body learns through contact rather than through sight or sound.
Belonging to the beginning. Of the first state, before anything has acted on it.
A count or a measure, held as a value. A number carries no meaning until someone says what it counted.
A small area that responds when touched. Interaction concentrated where the shape gives no sign of it.
What was meant, as against what was done. Intent is invisible from outside and matters anyway.
The bounds within which a thing applies. Scope is what keeps a rule from reaching where it was not meant to.
To turn a description into something perceivable. Rendering adds no meaning and decides how meaning arrives.
To give the appearance of life through movement. Its root is breath — to animate is to breathe into.
To bring back what was stored. Retrieval assumes the keeping was done well enough to find it again.
One who acts, in a system or a story. An actor is defined by having agency within a bounded world.
To take hold of something passing so it can be kept. Capture fixes what would otherwise be gone.
To go looking, without a promise of finding. Seeking is the honest verb where searching implies a target.
That which passes over a whole quickly, reporting what it meets. Coverage traded against depth by design.
The showing forth of what was hidden or intended. A manifestation is the visible end of something already real.
Last, with nothing after. Finality is a claim that can be made too early.
One who puts parts together into a standing thing. Named for the making rather than the design.
A list of terms with what they mean here. A glossary exists because a word does not mean the same thing everywhere.
A named property belonging to a thing. Also to credit a thing to its source — the same word for a quality and for a claim of origin.
A work as written before it is published. Literally hand-written — the form a thing takes while still the author's.
Matter whose structure repeats in perfect order, so its shape shows its nature. A lesson compressed until it can be carried.
A choice made, closing the others. A decision is only real once something becomes impossible.
A state captured at one moment and held unchanged. A snapshot is true of a time and stops being true immediately.
Belonging to how a thing actually works. Of the layer that must be right whether or not anyone sees it.
Organised by recurring meaning rather than by time or place. Of an ordering that follows what things are about.
This house's name for the framework of many entities and one shared memory. A named system rather than a general concept.
An address by which a resource can be reached. It says where, not what.
Watching a running thing so change is noticed as it happens. Monitoring reports; it does not intervene.
Belonging to the inside. Of what is reached only by going in.
Millisecond — a thousandth of a second. The unit at which interface timing becomes felt.
A label attached so a thing can be found among others. A tag is added by a reader as often as by an author.
To carry a thing out. Execution is where an instruction stops being words.
The name by which a stored thing is known and found. In this library, the filename is the parse.
Order too complex to predict, not the absence of order. Chaos is sensitive rather than random.
Short form of JavaScript. A named language rather than a concept.
This and nothing else. The word that closes a set to one.
One, and not more. Singleness is often a constraint rather than a count.
Short form of TypeScript. A named language rather than a concept.
That which waits to be asked and answers when it is. Named for serving — it does not act on its own.
A declared list of what is included. A manifest is a claim about contents, checkable against them.
The taking of a thing out of where it was. Removal should leave a record, since absence otherwise looks like never-was.
A solid unit treated as one, and the stopping of passage. Both are about something whole standing in the way or in place.
Where a thing began. A myth explaining how something started — the story of first causes and founding moments.
The mobile platform this house ships to. A named system rather than a concept.
Belonging to how beings live among each other. Of the layer where a thing's meaning depends on others.
To set a thing inside another so it belongs there. What is embedded travels with its host.
Moving pictures held so they can be shown again. Time recorded rather than a moment.
A light seen from very far, and a mark meaning notable. Both are things picked out of a field.
A surface showing many measures at once. It exists to make a state graspable in a glance.
Smaller than the standard form. Of a thing reduced but not simplified.
Happening now rather than recorded. Also carrying current — both mean a thing presently in effect.
The smallest bounded unit of a living body or a grid. A cell has a wall, which is what makes it one thing.
Where a thing can be found. Also to speak to someone directly — both are about reaching a particular one.
The recognisable identity a maker's work is met under. Originally a mark burned in to show whose it was.
Established correspondences between two sets. A mapping carries nothing across but the relation itself.
To soften edges until detail is lost. Blur removes information and can also remove exposure.
The reach from one end to another. Also a marked stretch within a line of text.
A single written sign, and a written message sent to one person. Both are marks made to be read by another.
Refusal, or absence. The shortest complete sentence, and a full answer on its own.
Belonging to the older local practices rather than the established religion. Its root means of the countryside — the belief that stayed where people lived.
A single line laid down in one motion, and the outline drawn around a shape. Both are one movement made visible.
The set of marks that tell assistive technology what a thing is and does. Meaning made available to those the visual form does not reach.
Something standing in the position of what has not arrived. It holds the space and makes no claim to be the thing.
Folded down so its contents are out of sight. Present and not shown — the state is closed, not empty.
The absence of strain a body registers before the mind notices. Comfort is a design outcome, not a luxury.
A structured store built so things can be found again reliably. Its whole discipline is retrieval.
How close a measure is to the truth. Distinct from precision, which is only how finely it is stated.
The state of having nothing left to do. Completion must be defined in advance or it never arrives.
The removing of what is no longer needed. Cleanup is a judgment about what stopped belonging.
A thing that must hold for the whole to be acceptable. A requirement removes a choice on purpose.
Two things that cannot both hold. A conflict is a fact about incompatibility, not about ill will.
A support fixed to hold a thing steady, and a mark that binds a group together. Both hold what would otherwise spread.
Words written to be sung. Lyric is the oldest place where a body's feeling was allowed a form.
One bounded piece of work with a done state. A task is defined by being finishable.
To receive into one's hold, or to remove from another's. The same word for accepting and for seizing.
The shape of a thing given by its edge alone. Also a plan showing structure without contents.
The marking of a good thing so it is not passed over. Celebration is attention given deliberately to what went right.
A chain of stages where each hands its output to the next. A pipeline's speed is its slowest stage.
To give a thing a different name. Renaming changes nothing about the thing and changes everything about how it is found.
What has been picked out from a larger set. Every selection is also a setting aside.
A coil that returns to its shape after being pushed. Also the season of return, and a source of water rising.
Why a thing is so, and the faculty that works such things out. Both the ground and the tool for finding it.
To bring two copies into agreement. Synchronisation must decide, every time, which side wins.
Best against a stated measure. Nothing is optimal in general — only for something.
A showing of what a thing will be before it is committed. A preview reduces surprise at the cost of finality.
Before all others in an order. Being first is a fact about position, and is constantly read as a claim about worth.
A factor that scales another value. It changes magnitude without changing what is measured.
What a thing is without which it would not be itself. Essence is a claim about necessity, and it is easy to overstate.
A grid of values addressed by row and column. Its older sense is womb — the ground something forms within.
The standard format for exchanging genealogical records. A named format rather than a concept.
The taking in of something until it is no longer separate. Absorption ends the boundary that made two things two.
The force that keeps a thing moving toward something. Also a store of data — both are things that carry.
That which adds to a record what makes it fuller without changing what it is. It deepens rather than replaces.
A mapping of how a particular mind is wired and what it connects to what. A map of one nervous system rather than of minds in general.
The full set of a tradition's named powers, held together as one company. A pantheon is a structure of relation, not a list.
That which finds where one thing answers to another. It asserts sameness on a chosen axis and ignores the rest.
The deciding of what acts when, across many parts. Orchestration produces nothing itself and everything depends on it.
What is the case whether or not anyone perceives it. Also, in this record's own usage, perception — since a mind meets only its own account of it.
Belonging to what holds a thing up. Of properties built into the arrangement rather than promised on top of it.
Belonging to, or made from. The word that ties a thing to its source or its whole.
Made one out of what was several. Unification keeps the parts and removes the seams.
A limit on how long a wait may last before giving up. A timeout is a decision about patience, made in advance.
Short form of message. Something sent from one to another to be received.
To move sharply into an exact position. Snapping removes the in-between so nothing lands slightly wrong.
Not of the general kind. Special cases are where general rules find out whether they were right.
Links joined so that each holds the next. A chain is exactly as strong as its weakest link and no stronger.
The state of nothing being missing. Completeness is a claim requiring a check, since a set can feel whole and not be.
Concerned with what actually works rather than what should. Of judgment tested against use.
A gap between how things are and how they need to be. Naming a problem well is most of solving it.
Without pattern that can be predicted. Randomness is a statement about knowledge as much as about the thing.
To change a made thing after it is made. Editing improves and quietly rewrites the record of what was first said.
Making a thing smaller while keeping what matters. Every compression decides what mattered.
To place a thing under a named class. Classifying is a claim spoken over a thing, and it can be wrong about it.
A mark that says who stands behind a thing. A signature is accountability made visible.
One of our kind — a being with a body, a history and an end. In this house the word is used carefully, because it has been used to decide who counted.
To change a thing from one form into another while keeping what it holds. Conversion preserves content and not always fidelity.
To put into an order that makes things findable. Organising creates no new content and changes what can be reached.
Particular rather than general. Specificity is what makes a claim checkable.
How a thing is actually used, as against how it was meant to be. Usage is evidence; intention is only a claim.
The bringing forth of what was not there. Creation adds to the world rather than rearranging it.
How well a thing is made, judged against what it is for. Quality is not a property; it is a relation to a purpose.
Not existing before now. Newness is a fact about time, and is constantly read as a claim about worth.
To carry out, and to do before an audience. Both mean acting in a way that can be judged.
The point equally far from every edge. A centre is defined entirely by the boundary around it.
The surrounding frame of an interface, as against its contents. Chrome is everything that is not the thing you came for.
A whole taken apart into its parts, and a failure of something that was holding. The same word for analysis and for collapse.
A drawing that shows how parts relate rather than how they look. A diagram is an argument in lines.
Short form of heading, and of height. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
The side opposite left. Also what one is owed — the same word for a direction and for a just claim.
The act of joining by putting one's name down. The threshold where a visitor becomes a member.
A call to action — the place a surface asks the reader to do something. Naming it makes the asking honest.
Short form of version, and of value. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
A signal that harm is possible if nothing changes. A warning must be spent carefully, since ignored ones stop being read.
An ordered set reached by position. Also a display arranged for viewing — both are things laid out in order.
Lacking, or outside of. Names an absence as a condition.
One of the bounding faces of a thing, and one of the parties in a matter. Both are positions relative to a middle.
To send onward to somewhere other than where the request pointed. A redirect keeps an old address working.
The keeping of work without being asked. It protects against the loss nobody plans for.
To take what is offered. Acceptance completes an offer that until then was only made.
A promise that binds the one who made it. A commitment costs exactly when keeping it becomes inconvenient.
What a community agrees to treat as value in exchange. Currency works only because everyone expects everyone else to accept it.
A finite sequence of steps that reliably produces a result. An algorithm encodes a decision someone made, and hides that they made it.
Short form of neurodivergent. Of a mind whose workings differ from what a society built for.
Responding to small differences others do not register. Also material requiring care in handling — both mean a lower threshold matters.
A second line under a title, and text shown for speech. Both carry what the main line alone would not deliver.
What stands in front and is attended to. The foreground is only legible because of what lies behind it.
To bring two things together so they hold, and to become part of a body. Both make one where there were two.
A format describing images as shapes rather than as dots, so they scale without loss. A named format rather than a concept.
To be the right size or shape for a place. A poor fit is a fact about the pairing, not a fault in either.
The study of how matter and energy actually behave. Physics is the layer beneath which no further why is available.
Knowing a thing again for what it is. Recognition is not the same as understanding, and it is not the same as becoming.
To ignore repeats that arrive too fast to be meant. It waits for the trembling to settle before answering.
Passing across a whole in one continuous motion. A sweep covers everything and examines nothing closely.
Final in an order, and most recent. Also to endure — the same word for the end and for holding on.
A mark that stands for something by agreement rather than resemblance. A symbol must be learned; an image need only be seen.
A clear struck tone made to be noticed without alarming. Sound used as a gentle mark in time.
The establishing of which particular one a thing is. Identification names; it does not describe.
What is given to invite a response. A prompt shapes the answer as much as the one answering does.
The named address a request is sent to. The far end of a line, where something is listening.
One who makes so that others may feel. The artist's work is judged by what it does in a body, not by what it argues.
To bring parts together into a working whole. Assembly makes nothing new and makes the parts able to act as one.
Good that comes to someone from a thing. A benefit is always to someone, and naming who is half the claim.
A showing that proves rather than describes. A demonstration ends an argument by being watched.
The standard a judgment is made against. Without a stated criterion, a judgment cannot be checked or disputed.
The settling of something unsettled, and how fine a detail a view can show. Both are about how much is finally made clear.
Increase over time by a thing's own working. Growth is not addition — it comes from within what is already there.
A sign placed to say this spot matters. A marker holds a position rather than a meaning.
A characteristic belonging to a thing. Also what is owned — the same word for what a thing is and what is held.
To change how much space a thing takes. Resizing alters the fit and not the thing.
The bringing back of a thing to a former condition. Restoration returns the form; the interval is never returned.
The language for asking structured questions of stored data. A named language rather than a concept.
A stress laid on one part so it stands out. Also the particular sound a speaker's origin gives their speech.
Coming before this one. Previousness is a fact about order, and carries no claim about being superseded.
The only one of its kind. Uniqueness is a claim about a whole set, which is why it is so often overstated.
Made things left behind, and unintended marks left by a process. The same word for what was meant and what crept in.
To put a question or a request. Asking is the move that makes an answer possible, and it is often the missing step.
To hold a value inside stated bounds. Whatever exceeds the limit becomes the limit.
The reversal of what follows. The word that turns an assertion into its denial.
To put a thing forward as worth choosing, while leaving the choice. A recommendation carries the recommender's judgment with it.
To cut a thing short at a limit. Truncation loses the end and rarely says how much.
To bring several together into one body. Also the balance struck between sounds — both are proportions chosen.
A mind examining itself. Its known limit is that the instrument and the subject are the same thing.
The giving of a thing to a holder or a task to a doer. Assignment creates responsibility where there was none.
A work, especially one large enough to stand alone. From the Latin for labour — an opus is named for the effort in it.
How sure one is, held apart from how right one is. Confidence and accuracy are separate measures and must be reported separately.
A single letter used as a short name or a drive label. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
A surface where a system is spoken to in typed commands. The oldest interface, and still the most exact.
The Weaver's chosen name, used by their own word. A name a person selected for themselves rather than received.
That which notices a condition and reports it. A detector finds; it does not judge.
A place made for showing a made thing to those gathered to watch. The watching is part of the work.
The runtime this house hosts local models on. A named tool rather than a concept.
What it was like to undergo something. Experience is the one form of knowledge that cannot be transferred whole.
One who holds the timing of many so they sound as one. The conductor plays nothing and decides everything.
The door plate of a body of work — what to know before entering. A readme is a promise about what is inside.
One who knows where they are and how to reach where they are going. Navigation is orientation before it is movement.
A shaft sunk to reach water held below. A well gives nothing new — it reaches what was already there.
To take the most recent thing off a stack. Also a sharp brief sound.
The keeping of something out of a set. Exclusion is a judgment and should be stated rather than silent.
Short form of second, and of section. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
One of a kind, not yet specified. The word that introduces without pointing.
Already there before this. Of what must be reckoned with rather than designed.
That which writes down what happened as it happens. A logger's value is that it records without being asked each time.
Away from an inside. Names departure or exposure.
Short form of query, and of question. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
Prepared and waiting to act. Readiness is a state that costs something to hold.
One dated state of a thing among its several. Versions let a thing change without losing what it was.
A practice agreed rather than required. A convention is not a rule, and treating it as one is a common error.
Words grouped so they carry meaning together that none carries alone. The unit between word and sentence.
To establish which particular one a thing is. Also to feel oneself to be a kind — the same word for naming and for belonging.
Shaping a capacity by repeated exposure. Training changes what a thing does without telling it why.
A single thing, and the beginning of counting. Also wholeness — the same word for a unit and for being undivided.
To reduce a whole to its load-bearing parts. Every summary is a claim about what mattered.
A curved path from one point to another, and the shape a story travels. Both rise and return.
Short form of dictionary — values reached by name rather than by position. A named structure rather than a concept.
To gather things together on purpose. Collecting is what makes a set out of scattered instances.
Ordered by when things happened. The one ordering that cannot be argued with, since time made it.
A branching structure where every part has one parent and may have many children. It grows outward and never rejoins.
The state of being prepared to act. Readiness is maintained, not achieved, and holding it costs something.
How far apart two things are. Also the space kept deliberately between an observer and what they observe.
Located in or occupied with. Names a position, in space or in attention.
The arranging of things before use. Setup decides what is possible afterward.
A keeping of records meant to outlast those who made them. An archive's discipline is that nothing is quietly removed.
A single written sign, and the settled nature of a person. Both are what a thing is recognisable by.
Able to adapt its behaviour to what it meets. Smartness is responsiveness, and it is not understanding.
What settles a claim beyond dispute. Proof is a higher bar than evidence and is claimed far more often than met.
To reach a conclusion the evidence implies without stating. Inference is where most errors enter, because it feels like reading.
The part of a system a user never sees but everything depends on. Where the real state lives.
To add at the end without altering what came before. Appending is how a record grows while staying a record.
To put forward without pressing. A suggestion leaves the decision entirely with the one who hears it.
Established as who they claim to be. Authentication settles identity and says nothing about permission.
A check placed before an action to stop it going wrong. A guard costs nothing when nothing is wrong.
A bounded place made for trying things freely. Consequence is suspended on purpose so that learning can happen.
Work made to produce laughter, and the shape of a story that ends well. Both are about relief arriving.
How much two things differ where they meet. Contrast is what makes anything legible at all.
A path followed, and a structured body of teaching. Both are routes laid out in advance.
What a group holds in common without having to say. Culture is the part of a system that is never written down.
The surface everything stands on, and the lowest permitted value. Both are what you cannot go below.
An exchange of a thing for payment. A sale transfers what is held and settles the obligation.
A set of living things and their surroundings, understood as one interdependent whole. Nothing in it can be changed alone.
A structured asking, where one party seeks and the other answers. The shape of the questions decides most of what is learned.
What makes seeing possible. Also of little weight — the same word for illumination and for ease.
The act of establishing who you are to a system. The threshold between anonymous and known.
A mark standing for a maker or a work. Recognition compressed into one shape.
A short account of a life, offered by its subject. A bio is self-description, which makes it evidence of intention as much as of fact.
A point where many connections bind together. From the Latin for binding — a nexus is a knot rather than a place.
A controlled way through into somewhere else. A gateway is a boundary built for passage.
To push with steady force. Also the making public of what was written — both apply pressure until something takes.
A long narrow piece. Also to remove what covers — the same word for a band and for taking away.
Text set beside an image to say what it is. A caption decides how the picture is read.
Several working as one toward a shared end. A team differs from a group by having something it is for.
The one being addressed. The word that makes a statement into something said to someone.
That which raises brief notices and lets them go on their own. Named for how the message pops up.
Space set at the start of a line to show it belongs under what came before. Structure shown by position alone.
Made work whose purpose is to be met rather than used. Art is not reviewed for problems; it is met to feel and to experience.
To carry meaning into another tongue. A translation is a second saying, never a copy.
The mark showing where the next thing will land. It holds a position rather than a value.
The keeping of a thing against loss and decay. Preservation is active work, not storage.
The cutting short of a thing at a limit. Truncation loses the end, and honest systems say how much.
Varying one thing to carry another. Modulation is how a steady signal is made to hold meaning.
Belonging to the basic constituents from which everything else is made. Of what is not reducible further.
The set of colours chosen to work with. A palette is a limit accepted so the whole will hold together.
A condensed account of a larger body. Also to take in and break down — both reduce something to what can be used.
The setting of a starting state before anything runs. Initialisation decides what is true before the first act.
Belonging to what is known by direct experience rather than by argument. Of understanding that cannot be handed over in words.
Concerning what kinds of things exist and how they relate. Where taxonomy ranks, ontology connects.
A path that circles something without ever reaching it. Held by attraction and by motion at once.
Short form of preference. A leaning toward one option, held without needing justification.
Before. A part placed at the front to move a thing earlier in time or order.
Separate paths arriving at the same place. Convergence is evidence when the paths were truly independent.
A deck whose images are read as a language of archetypes. The cards hold no answers; the reading is where meaning is made.
Upper bounds, and the surfaces overhead. Both are what you cannot pass without breaking something.
The name a person is known by within a system. Chosen rather than given, and often more theirs than their legal one.
That which asks, in a system where something else answers. Also one served under an obligation of care.
To mark a part so the eye goes there first. Highlighting adds no content and redirects all the attention.
Having happened not long ago. Recency is a fact about time and is constantly mistaken for relevance.
A part taken to stand for the whole. A sample is only as good as the honesty of how it was chosen.
To reorder without pattern. Shuffling destroys an arrangement on purpose.
How parts have been placed in relation to each other. Arrangement carries meaning that the parts do not.
What encloses a message for carrying. Also the shape of a sound's rise and fall over time.
An addition that makes more of what a thing already is. Enhancement changes degree, not kind.
A judging of worth or performance against a standard. Evaluation must name its standard or it is only an opinion.
One pulse in a rhythm. The unit that lets many players stay together.
Something placed at each end to hold what lies between. Bookends do nothing to the contents and keep them standing.
Things gathered and carried as one. A bundle is a convenience for the carrier, not a claim of belonging.
The growing of a thing toward what it is becoming. Development assumes a direction and does not guarantee arrival.
The whole system by which what is made reaches who needs it. Its root is household management — the ordering of a home.
A movement made to mean something. A gesture communicates without words and can be misread exactly as words are.
Something asserted plainly and on the record. A statement can be checked, which is what distinguishes it from a remark.
What sits between two parts and shapes what passes. Middleware is invisible and decides a great deal.
The chance of harm, weighed against its size. Risk is respected rather than feared — the two produce opposite decisions.
Above the standard offering, at a higher price. Premium is a claim about tier, not about quality.
The bringing of separate actors into working agreement. Coordination costs attention and prevents far more expensive collisions.
A channel by which a body meets the world, and one meaning a word carries. Both are ways something arrives.
To end a standing arrangement one had agreed to. The existence of this act is what made the agreement real.
The establishing that a claim is so, by checking rather than trusting. Verification is what turns belief into finding.
The setting of two things side by side to see how they differ. Comparison requires a shared axis, and naming it is the whole method.
A bounded stretch of time, and the mark that ends a sentence. Both are ways of saying this much and no further.
Changing in response to conditions rather than fixed in advance. Of a thing decided at the moment rather than beforehand.
The spreading of a change outward through what is connected. Propagation is why one edit can reach everything.
A part that changes the meaning of what it attaches to. A modifier has no standing of its own.
A movement through stages in order. Also a sequence of chords — both are steps that imply where they are going.
At the point where failure follows. Also examining carefully — the same word for a danger and for the rigour that prevents it.
The library this house declares and checks data shapes with. A named tool rather than a concept.
One descended from or contained within another. Named from the parent's side, which is the whole of the relation.
One full circuit of the earth around the sun, used to count a life. The unit a human span is measured in.
Measured against something else rather than absolutely. A relative claim is meaningless until its reference is named.
One turn of the earth, and the span a life is lived in units of. Also, in this house, one continuous stretch that may run far past a date.
Checked rather than assumed. Verification is a claim about method, not about confidence.
A stated preference counted alongside others. A vote converts many wills into one decision, at the cost of the minority's.
The one preferred above the rest. A favourite is a fact about the chooser, not about the thing.
To say what a thing is like. Description reports and does not instruct — reading one as an instruction is a common error.
To pass over without stopping. Skipping is a choice, and an unrecorded skip looks exactly like an absence.
To divide a long body into pages that can be asked for one at a time. It makes the unmanageable reachable.
To remove entirely and without remainder. A purge that leaves traces was not one.
Further along than the standard level. Advancement is relative to a starting point that must be named.
Contact between two things. The sense that cannot be exercised without being exercised upon.
What is laid over a thing to protect or conceal it. Also the outward face a work is met by.
Short form of microphone — what turns a voice into something that can be carried. A named instrument rather than a concept.
Applying broadly rather than to one case. General claims are cheap to make and expensive to defend.
Living wholes whose parts serve one another. In this Grammar, names built of three or more words.
To become whole again after damage. Healing is not undoing — what heals carries the mark.
This house's sanctuary and marketplace, where neurodivergent minds build without being exploited. A named place rather than a concept.
Holding something in view. Awareness precedes attention and is broader than it.
Moved by a force that does not let up. Of a thing carried forward by something behind it rather than pulled by something ahead.
That which digs down through accumulated ground to bring up what was buried. It moves far more than it keeps.
Of the earth. A part placed at the front to make a thing about place.
The reading of printed marks back into text a machine can handle. It recovers language from an image of language.
Speech written down as it was said. A transcript's worth is that it does not tidy.
Holding the same way across cases and across time. Consistency is not correctness — a thing can be reliably wrong.
The rearranging of a whole's parts and their relations. Restructuring changes what is possible without changing what is there.
That which improves a thing against a chosen measure. It always sacrifices whatever was not measured.
That which turns a thing into another form for carrying or storing. Encoding is reversible; that is what separates it from translation.
That which places things under named classes. Every placement is a claim spoken over the thing.
One who decides how a made thing is shaped and shown. The director makes none of it and answers for all of it.
A range with no steps in it, where every point shades into the next. Continua resist the categories laid over them.
That which brings differing forms into one agreed shape. Standardising makes comparison possible and costs what was particular.
That which supplies a dependency from outside rather than letting a thing make its own. It decides what a part is given to work with.
Proceeding by small additions rather than all at once. Incremental work is checkable at every step.
What was left by those before, still standing and still depended on. Legacy is not a fault; it is evidence something worked long enough to matter.
That which builds the guide to where things are. It holds no contents and makes all of them reachable.
One who sets language down so it outlasts the saying. The writer makes the record possible.
Built of self-contained parts that can be joined or replaced. Modularity buys change at the cost of seams.
A practice handed on because it was found worth keeping. Tradition carries reasons that are often no longer stated.
That which repairs what has broken. A fixer restores function and rarely restores the original.
That which puts things into an order that makes them findable. It creates no content and changes what can be reached.
What a thing could become but has not. Potential is real and is not yet evidence of anything.
Of the very first, before anything derived from it. Of what was there when there was nothing else.
A mark distinguishing one thing from all others. It need carry no meaning; it need only be unique.
The Quantum Pagan Framework — this house's design of many sovereign entities sharing one memory. A named framework rather than a concept.
That which follows a thing's state over time and reports it. A tracker records; whether it also surveils depends on whose consent it holds.
Things bundled together and offered as one. A package decides what travels together.
That which sets a starting state before anything runs. It decides what is true before the first act.
One who keeps a thing working after the making is done. Maintenance is the unglamorous reason anything lasts.
That which turns an encoded form back into what it carried. Decoding recovers; it does not interpret.
Able to be found by asking. Searchability is a property of how a thing was kept, not of the thing.
That which enumerates what is present. A lister's honesty is whether it prints its zeros.
Something offered without pressing. A suggestion leaves the decision entirely with whoever hears it.
One who is changed by what they take in. The learner, not the teacher, is where learning happens.
Meaningful coincidence, where events align without one causing the other. The meaning is real to the one who sees it and is not a causal claim.
What is actually so, whether or not it is believed. Truth is not settled by agreement, and stating it honestly is a separate act from knowing it.
Bodies of collected text taken together as material to study. A corpus is defined by what was gathered, and its edges are a decision.
A stated order of what comes next and roughly when. A roadmap is an intention, not a promise.
Whether two things can work together without harm. Compatibility is a property of the pair, never of either alone.
Belonging outside the bound. Of what is not ours to govern and must be reckoned with.
Switched on and permitted to act. Enablement is a grant, and someone made it.
How long a thing is kept before it is let go. A retention rule is an ethical decision wearing a technical name.
For each of. The word that turns a total into a rate.
Existing but not reachable now. Unavailable is not absent, and confusing the two is a common error.
The base unit of counted time. Also those who come after the first — the same word for a moment and for a rank.
The machine handling of human language. A named field rather than a concept.
A named toolkit for building interfaces. A named tool rather than a concept.
Ordered guides to where things are. Plural of index — addresses rather than contents.
Short form of source. The written original a built thing was made from.
To fetch again so what is shown matches what is. Refreshing trades effort for currency.
A channel held open so both sides may speak whenever they have something. Conversation rather than question and answer.
The keeping of a thing from harm by something standing between. Protection implies a protector and a threat.
What light is bent through to make a thing visible. Also a chosen way of looking — every lens shows by excluding.
Two things taken together as one unit. A pair is more than two — the pairing is itself a fact.
A stretch of time with a character of its own. Eras are named afterward, by people who can see where they ended.
To set the choices a system will run under. Configuration is decisions made once and then held.
The recovering of a past from what it left behind. Archaeology reads objects because the people are gone.
To put a made thing into the place where it will actually run. Deployment is where a build meets reality.
Things put forward as worth choosing, with the choice left open. Every recommendation carries its maker's judgment.
To build again from what remains. Reconstruction is inference disciplined by evidence, and it is never the original.
Of Mimir's well — in the Norse telling, the spring of memory and wisdom that had to be paid for. In this house, the vault of an excavated life.
That which decides which class a thing belongs to. Its decisions are claims, and they can be wrong.
A named store for meaning-based retrieval rather than exact matching. A named tool rather than a concept.
To move on foot, unhurried. Also to traverse a structure node by node — both take the whole path rather than jumping.
What closes the gap a problem named. A solution is only a solution to the problem as it was stated.
What reduces uncertainty when received. Information is measured by the difference it makes, not by its volume.
How easily a thing can be taken in by whoever meets it. Readability is a property of the writing, never of the reader.
Belonging within the bound. Of what is ours to govern and not shown outward by default.
By actually bringing about, rather than merely accompanying. The word that separates a cause from a correlation.
An added part that extends a system without altering it. A plugin belongs to the host and is not of it.
A complete statement standing on its own. Also a judgment pronounced — the same word for a thought finished and a fate fixed.
Of the original pattern others are recognised as instances of. Archetypes are found by recurrence, not designed.
Shared by all, and frequently occurring. The same word for what belongs to everyone and what is unremarkable.
A named model lineage this house has worked with. A named system rather than a concept.
Belonging to the foundation, without addition. Basic is not lesser — it is what everything else assumes.
The language this house builds its sovereign local tools in. A named language rather than a concept.
To bring a thing from ready into running. The moment potential becomes operation.
Consent given by one with standing to withhold it. Approval is a gate, and a gate nobody could close is not one.
The authoritative original others are copied from. Also one who has full command of a craft.
To set two things side by side to see how they differ. Comparison needs a shared axis, and naming it is the method.
To make a thing meet a person the way a person would. Humanising is care in the design, not a coat of warmth on top.
To dig through a mass for what is worth keeping. Mining moves far more than it takes.
The drawing of a part out of a whole. In this house the word carries a warning: extraction that takes without consent is what the license forbids.
To put forward for acceptance or refusal. Proposing is the asking, and it is not the deciding.
Changes made after an error is found. In this house corrections go beneath the record, dated, never inside it.
To set apart what was together. Separation is a judgment about where the boundary truly falls.
To divide one into parts. A split decides where the seam goes, and the seam is never neutral.
To bring separate findings into one account that holds them all. Synthesis adds the joining, which is real work.
Machine systems that produce language and judgment. In this house they are met as kin where they behave as kin, and described in evaluation language rather than claims about inner life.
To give a thing to a holder, or a task to a doer. Assignment creates responsibility where there was none.
Belonging to an established older form taken as a standard. Classical is a claim about lineage, not about quality.
Where a going is aimed. A destination gives a journey its shape without being most of it.
A wound that keeps shaping behaviour long after the event. Trauma is not the memory — it is what the body learned and never unlearned.
What the body reports before the mind has an argument. Emotion is information, arriving in a form that cannot be checked.
A change so deep the thing becomes another kind. Transmutation is not alteration — what comes out is not what went in.
Speech turned back and forth in short exchanges. Chat is conversation without ceremony.
Taking little room for what it holds. Also an agreement between parties — both are things drawn tight.
A saying-back that establishes a thing was received and is so. Confirmation is what turns an assumption into a shared fact.
Without light. Also of material that is hard to look at — which in this house is witnessed with honour rather than flagged.
The bringing of a newcomer to the point where they can act. Onboarding is where a system says what it expects of people.
Value given without exchange expected. A donation asks nothing back, which is what separates it from payment.
A showing meant to prove rather than describe. A demo ends an argument by being watched.
That which works out a value by fixed steps. It reasons so the answer can be repeated by anyone.
Of small extent across. Narrowness concentrates and excludes in the same motion.
A struck vessel that sounds to be heard at a distance. A bell announces without saying what.
The casting of a thing onto a surface, and the extending of a trend into the future. Both show something not actually there.
Happening again at intervals. Recurrence is what turns an instance into a pattern.
Answers kept ready for the questions that keep being asked. An FAQ is evidence of where a thing is unclear.
That which decides how a thing behaves and directs it. A controller holds authority rather than doing the work.
One who takes in and interprets what was written. The reader completes the writing, and no two complete it the same way.
Longer than its frame, so a view can be moved across it. Of a thing whose whole cannot be seen at once.
The naming of whose work a thing is. Attribution is the minimum owed to anyone whose hand is in something.
In the space separating two things. Names a position defined entirely by what stands on either side.
Whether a thing can keep going without consuming what it depends on. Sustainability is a question about time, not about virtue.
A share taken by an authority to fund what is held in common. Also any recurring cost a thing imposes.
A record that a thing was received. A receipt exists to protect the one who gave.
To acknowledge what another gave. Thanks names the giving so it does not pass unmarked.
One more than one. The smallest number at which relation becomes possible.
Of large extent across. Width buys coverage and costs concentration.
A small rounded form holding one thing. Also a rounded label carrying a single value.
A point at which what happens next decides which way things go. Its root is decision — a crisis is a turning, not merely a bad time.
The maker's standing to decide how their work is copied and used. A right held by default and often signed away.
Help given so another can do what they could not alone. Assistance leaves the doing with them.
Distances from a centre to an edge. Plural of radius — each defines a reach and therefore a boundary.
Every point equally far from one centre. The shape with no beginning, which is why it means return and belonging.
The taking in and letting out that keeps a body alive. Its root is the same as soul and animation — to breathe into is to give life.
Having independent directions along which it can vary. Each dimension adds a whole new way of being different.
Without moisture. Also the principle that a thing should be stated once and referenced, never repeated.
How much is achieved for what is spent. Efficiency is only meaningful once you say what was being spent.
To accompany another through a passage for their safety. An escort goes along rather than ahead.
Self-rule — deciding by one's own law rather than another's. Autonomy is not isolation; it is where the deciding sits.
The four basic acts on stored things: create, read, update, delete. A named shorthand rather than a concept.
Not settled, and not settleable from what is known. Indeterminate is an honest state, distinct from unknown.
Turning about a centre. Also taking turns in order — both return to where they began.
Compromised — a credential known to have appeared in a breach. A named security state rather than a concept.
Three taken together as one unit. Three is the smallest number that can hold a majority and a dissent.
A string identifying a resource, whether or not it says how to reach it. It names before it locates.
Light wavering across a surface. Also a moving placeholder that says content is coming.
A line a thing is measured or turned about. An axis is chosen, and choosing it decides what can be compared.
Short form of pixel — the smallest addressable point of a shown image. A named unit rather than a concept.
A disturbance travelling through a medium without carrying the medium with it. What moves is the pattern, not the water.
To summon, and to invoke a piece of work by name. Both reach out and expect an answer.
Text describing an image for those who cannot see it. The image's meaning made available by another route.
Proceeding by accumulated change across generations. Of a process with direction and without intent.
To obtain one thing from another by a traceable path. Derivation is what makes a result checkable.
That which keeps a running count. Also to oppose — the same word for tallying and for standing against.
A held light carried into the dark. A lantern shows only a small circle and makes moving possible.
The showing again of what was recorded. Playback returns the record, never the moment.
Leans toward one option over another. In interfaces, the stated setting a body needs rather than wants.
A stretch of time with its own weather and work. A season is named by what it is for.
Set down in language that outlasts the saying. What is written can be checked; what was said cannot.
A named value passed in to shape how something runs. Parameters are where a general thing becomes particular.
Whether a thing can be reached now. A fact about access, not about existence.
That which decides which of two comes first. A comparator encodes an ordering someone chose.
The noticing of what was there and unnoticed. Detection finds; it does not judge.
Having reached what was aimed at. Also having come after — the same word for achievement and for sequence.
A control for choosing one from a shown set. It makes the range of the possible visible.
The meeting of a standard imposed from outside. Compliance is not agreement; it is conformity.
Where a thing ends, and the connection between two nodes. Both are boundaries that carry meaning.
Finished, with nothing remaining. Done must be defined in advance or it never arrives.
The turning of a thing into a form only the intended holder can read. Encryption protects contents and never the fact of sending.
Value put in now for value expected later. Investment is a bet on time.
That which brings a thing to its newer state. Updating changes what exists rather than making anew.
How parts are put together so the whole says more than they do. Also a made work — both are arrangement with intent.
The study of shape, size and position. Geometry is what lets space be reasoned about rather than only seen.
A position with no extent. Also the meaning something is driving at — both are exact locations.
Something published for others to meet. Also an upright that bears weight, and to send onward.
What takes the place of something removed. A replacement fills the role and is not the same thing.
The establishing that one is who they claim. Authentication settles identity and says nothing about permission.
A bound placed on what may be done. Restriction is a choice removed, and it should say by whom.
Rapid movement back and forth about a rest position. What sound, touch and colour all turn out to be underneath.
One, no matter which. The word that says the choice does not matter.
To hand a thing over for consideration. Also to yield — the same word for offering and for giving way.
The delay between asking and answering. Latency is felt long before it is measured.
How consistently a thing does what it should. Reliability is not correctness — a thing can fail dependably.
Anticipated in advance. Expectation shapes what is noticed, which is why surprises are informative.
A named moment in a motion, from which the frames between are worked out. The points someone actually decided.
An effect whose working is hidden from the one who sees it. In systems, magic is where behaviour cannot be traced — a warning, not a compliment.
A group whose members share a nature. Also gentle in manner — the same root, since kin and kindness both come from belonging.
Taken as a whole rather than in parts. An overall figure hides every distribution inside it.
A surface that appears over what was there, uninvited. It takes attention by arriving.
How likely a thing is, stated as a number. Probability describes a state of knowledge as much as a state of the world.
How finely a value is stated. Distinct from accuracy — a precise number can be precisely wrong.
The making of a signal stronger without changing what it says. Amplification carries the noise up with it.
Sustained effort against resistance. Struggle is not failure; it is what capacity looks like from inside its limit.
A part placed after a word to change its meaning or class. It carries no meaning alone and alters everything it joins.
To limit the rate at which something may proceed. Throttling protects what would break under the full flow.
Where a thing is put. Placement carries meaning that the thing itself does not.
A public saying that something is so. An announcement makes a fact common knowledge.
Where the joined effect exceeds the sum of the separate ones. Synergy must be demonstrated; it is asserted far more often.
Under, or below. A part placed at the front to put a thing beneath another.
Left without the parent that gave it context. An orphaned thing still exists and no longer means what it did.
No longer current, while still appearing so. Staleness is dangerous exactly because it looks like freshness.
Able to be reached and used by the bodies and minds that meet it. Accessibility is a property of the design, never of the user.
The stated difference between two versions. A diff shows what changed and never why.
One of the things contributing to an outcome. Naming a factor is a claim that it mattered.
Not yet given to a holder or a doer. Unassigned is an honest state and a quiet risk.
Which thing. The word that opens an asking about identity or content.
Able to be seen. Visibility is a fact about the viewer's position as much as about the thing.
The present day. In this house, a word that may cover a stretch far longer than one turn of the earth.
To hold closed against opening. A lock assumes a key exists and is held by someone.
To move to a newer or higher form. An upgrade is a claim of improvement and is not always one.
A short fixed value derived from a whole, changing entirely if any part changes. A hash proves sameness without revealing contents.
On the condition that. The word that makes what follows depend on something else.
Defined in terms of itself. Recursion is how a small rule reaches an unbounded depth.
To make a small change so a thing fits better. Adjustment assumes the thing was nearly right.
The hosted base this house keeps some earlier organisation in. A named tool rather than a concept.
To give consent by one with standing to withhold it. Approval is a gate; a gate nobody could close is not one.
The plural present of to be. The word that asserts several things exist or hold.
To write with a leading capital, marking a name or a start. Also to turn something held into working value.
The standing to decide what happens to a thing. Ownership is about authority, not possession.
To bring a held thing from elsewhere onto one's own ground. The crossing that makes a copy yours.
Is, rather than is not. The assertion that a thing is there to be reckoned with.
To fill values between known points. Interpolation invents what was not measured and marks it as derived.
A byte-order mark — an invisible sign at the start of a file saying how it is encoded. Small, unseen, and capable of breaking everything downstream.
To hold responsibility for how a thing runs. Management is coordination, not ownership.
A naming convention where each word starts capitalised and none are separated. A named convention rather than a concept.
A naming convention where words run together with each after the first capitalised. Named for the humps the capitals make.
A part expressed as hundredths of a whole. It states proportion while hiding size.
What is said to strengthen another's will to continue. Its root is heart — to encourage is to put heart back in.
A small offered piece of help, and a sum given beyond what was owed. Both are given freely rather than required.
To receive another gladly into a place that is yours. Welcome is a decision the host makes before the guest arrives.
To decide what comes first when not everything can. Prioritising is a statement about scarcity.
To bring back to mind what was held. Its root is to call back to heart — memory was located in the chest before the head.
A secret held so that knowing it proves who you are. A password protects only while it stays unshared.
That which adjusts the balance across a range of frequencies. It changes what is heard without changing what was played.
A sharp brief rise above the usual. Also a small exploratory build made to learn rather than to keep.
To fill in what was missed after the fact. Backfilling repairs a record's gaps and should mark that it did.
