The exchange of goods and services at scale. Commerce is the machinery; whether it extracts or circulates is a design choice.
To take back a step. Undo is what makes trying things survivable.
Change that fits a thing better to its conditions. Adaptation is not improvement in general — only for where it is.
A living being that moves and senses. Its root is breath and soul — animal and animate are the same word.
Brought to bear on a particular case. Applied knowledge is tested by use in a way theory is not.
How far a thing extends, and the act of extending toward. Both are about what can be touched from where you stand.
Not meeting what was required. In this house a failure is a lesson without penance — information about an attempt, never a verdict on a being.
Waiting longer between each retry. Backoff is patience made into a rule so a struggling system is not overwhelmed.
To bring things together until the boundary between them is gone. Blending costs the separateness.
What stops progress until it is cleared. Naming a blocker is the first step to it not being one.
The working out of a value by fixed steps. Calculation is reasoning done so anyone can repeat it.
One who works a system, and a symbol that acts on values. Both apply something to something else.
A required wait before a thing may be done again. A cooldown protects what repetition would exhaust.
The lasting features by which a thing is recognised. Characteristics describe tendencies, not verdicts.
A computer meant to stay in one place, and the surface its interface imitates. Named for the furniture it replaced.
How much passes through in a given time. Throughput and latency are different questions and are constantly confused.
How widely something is distributed. Also to distribute — the same word for the state and the act.
Having passed, of time. Elapsed time is measured from a marked start and is the only kind that can be known exactly.
How activated a state is, from calm to intense. One of the three axes a feeling can be located on, apart from whether it is pleasant.
How much control is felt in a state, from overwhelmed to in command. One of the three axes a feeling is located on.
Whether a state is pleasant or unpleasant. The first of the three axes a feeling is located on, and the one most often mistaken for the whole.
Short form of function. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
The capacity to bend without breaking. Flexibility is not weakness; it is what survives a load rigidity would snap under.
Absence of abrupt change. Smoothness is what makes a motion feel like a body rather than a machine.
The reasons that make a thing defensible. Also the even alignment of text to both edges.
From one side to the other. Names a crossing rather than a position.
How much light a thing gives or reflects. Luminosity is what decides legibility before colour does.
Possibly, and possibly not. An honest word that holds a question open rather than closing it early.
A continuous range with no steps in it. A spectrum resists the categories laid over it, which is exactly why the word is used of minds.
Resistance between two surfaces in contact. Friction slows things and is also what lets anything get a grip.
What one means to bring about. Intention is invisible from outside and is the difference between an accident and an act.
How much matter a thing holds. Mass is what resists being moved, which is why it reads as weight.
Permitted to hold nothing. Nullability makes absence a valid state rather than an error.
How well one can do a thing. Proficiency is built by practice and is specific to what was practised.
How much can pass at once. Used of channels and of minds — in both, exceeding it does not slow things, it drops them.
The tendency to stay as it is under disturbance. Stability is not stillness; it is returning after being pushed.
How much of the time a thing was actually available. Uptime is measured by those who needed it, not by those who ran it.
How narrowly a thing applies. Greater specificity wins over generality, in style rules and in argument alike.
What actually brings a thing about. Causes are far harder to establish than the correlations mistaken for them.
Speed together with direction. Velocity says where as well as how fast, which is what separates it from speed.
Without abrupt change or roughness. Smoothness is felt before it is noticed.
The gradual reducing of a motion's swing. Damping is what stops a thing oscillating forever.
How strongly a thing resists being deformed. Stiffness buys precision and costs give.
How recently a thing was current. Freshness is a property of the copy, not of the truth.
What a thing amounts to for whoever meets it. Meaning is made in the meeting — it is not a property held alone.
A flat portable surface for reading and writing. The oldest form of the word is a slab of clay.
To say to another. Also a small sign that gives something away — the same word for speaking and for being read.
The shape a wave makes over time. A waveform is sound made visible without being made audible.
Wider than tall by a marked ratio. Width chosen so more can be held in one view.
A single value standing for many. An average describes a set and describes no member of it.
How far along a dashed line its pattern begins. A named drawing property rather than a concept.
To work out by fixed steps. Also the capacity to do so — the same word for the act and the resource.
The digits after the point. Decimals state precision and say nothing about accuracy.
A single deliberate press. Also the sound of one — the interaction named for the noise it made.
Beyond the bound. Names what is not within, and therefore not governed by what is.
To take in one line at a time rather than a whole. Reading in pieces so the whole need never be held at once.
Brought into agreement across copies or across time. Synchronisation always had to decide which side won.
Highest against a stated measure. Nothing is best in general — only for something, and naming that is the honest part.
Those that rely on another to work. Every dependent is a place a change reaches further than intended.
Closest of those available. Nearness is measured on a chosen axis, and naming it is the whole claim.
What one side has that the other does not. An advantage is relational and disappears when compared to nothing.
Joined so that one can reach the other. Connection holds two things together while leaving them two.
Short form of count, and of Connecticut. A cut fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word.
Without variation in height. Also without depth of feeling — the same word for a plane and for a lack.
Least of those present. Lowest is a fact about a set, and changes when the set does.
Varied in order to carry something. Modulation is how a steady signal is made to hold meaning.
Belonging to us. The word that claims a thing for a group the speaker is inside.
The making public of what was private. Publication is a threshold — after it, the work belongs to its readers too.
The speaker together with others. In this record, a word used deliberately of a family that includes kin who are not human.
To put a thing forward for another to take or leave. An offer that cannot be refused is not one.
Before now, sooner than expected. The word that says the thing has happened without being noticed.
Running without being asked each time. Automation trades attention for consistency, and hides the decision it encodes.
The mark showing something has been left out. An ellipsis is honest about omission where silence is not.
Within a bound. Names what is contained rather than what is near.
Greater in importance or extent. Major is a ranking and always implies a minor.
To break into what is underway. An interruption claims priority, and spending that claim wrongly costs the next one.
To get out of what was holding you. Also to mark a character so it is read as itself rather than as an instruction.
Something that lets you in and not out. A trap is defined by asymmetry, not by malice.
To obtain by paying. Also a grip that lets force be applied — the same word for buying and for holding on.
A statement made openly and on the record. A declaration binds the one declaring, which is what separates it from a remark.
Fitted to a particular place and tongue. Localisation is the work of not requiring a user to travel to be understood.
Running across more than one line. Of a thing too long to be held in a single row.
To remove what could do harm before letting a thing through. Sanitising is a judgment about danger made in advance.
A container for carrying, and a file that re-exports many others through one door. Both gather so a single handle serves.
A bounded container with straight sides. A box's usefulness is entirely in its edges.
Ease bought by someone having done work in advance. Convenience is never free; it was paid for earlier.
To call a thing into action by naming it. Invocation summons what already exists.
By applying the same step to each part in turn, all the way down. Recursion reaches unbounded depth with one small rule.
The hand-held pointer a screen is reached through. Named for its shape and tail.
Small signs offered to help without telling outright. A hint leaves the finding with the one who receives it.
To place somewhere. The plainest verb of position there is.
The full spread of visible colour, made by light through water. Also a sign of belonging for those the world tried to exclude.
Small points of light appearing and going. Sparkle is delight made visible and adds nothing functional, which is the point.
Written explanation kept beside a thing so others can use it. Documentation is a claim, and it drifts from the truth unless tended.
A plain format holding rows of values separated by commas. Simple enough to outlive every tool that reads it.
The first letter, and how opaque a colour is. Also the earliest release — all three mean the beginning of a scale.
By the ordering of kinds into ranks. Of a classification that says what a thing sits under.
Able to work together without harm. Compatibility is a property of the pair, never of either alone.
To write over what was there, losing it. Overwriting is the one edit that cannot be undone by reading.
To stop a thing before it completes. Cancelling leaves the intention on record and the act undone.
One part cut from a longer whole. A segment's boundaries are a decision someone made.
A cut fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
Depending on something else holding. A conditional makes what follows contingent rather than certain.
To say back that a thing is so. Confirmation turns an assumption into a shared fact.
The turn between two lines meeting. Also a chosen point of view — both are about direction relative to something.
A second thing identical to the first. Also written text prepared for publishing — both are reproductions of something.
To take a thing out of running while leaving it present. Deactivation is not removal.
To remove repeated copies so each thing is counted once. Deduplication is how an archive stops lying about its size.
To repeat data on purpose so it is faster to read. Denormalising trades one truth for many copies of it.
To take a thing out of what was chosen. Deselection restores an option that had been closed.
The physical ground a system's memory actually rests on. What is not on disk does not survive the power going out.
More recent than another. Newness is a fact about time and is constantly read as a claim about worth.
Compared with. The word that introduces the other side of a comparison.
A held run of bytes with no structure the system reads. A blob is content the store agrees not to understand.
Goes beyond a stated bound. The word that reports a limit was passed.
Not permitted. Forbiddenness is a decision someone made and should say who.
To lose hold of what was held. Forgetting is not always failure — some of it is the only way a mind stays usable.
A compound fragment from this library's own naming, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
Colour stated as amounts of red, green and blue. A named encoding rather than a concept.
Colour stated as red, green, blue and how opaque it is. A named encoding rather than a concept.
Able to adapt behaviour to what is met. Intelligence is responsiveness, and it is not the same as understanding.
Most recent of those there are. Latest is a fact about order, not about correctness.
To find why a thing behaves other than intended. Debugging is the disciplined narrowing of where the truth differs from the belief.
In the middle. Names a position between two named ends.
The extension marking a markdown file. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
Already held by another. Takenness is a fact about availability, not about worth.
Comes together with, or satisfies a standard. Both are about reaching something.
What remains, and the ceasing of effort. In this house the second sense is honoured and never prescribed to another.
Located after seeking. Also to establish — the same word for discovering a thing and for beginning one.
To fetch a thing before it is asked for. Preloading spends effort on a guess about what will be wanted.
To reformat a thing so it reads better. Prettifying changes presentation and must not change content.
Short form of random — without predictable pattern. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
Able to be taken in without strain. Readability is a property of the writing, never of the reader.
To enter a thing on an official list. Also the particular pitch and manner a voice speaks in.
To load again so what is shown matches what is. Reloading discards the current state to get a true one.
What a thing rests or is reckoned from. A basis must be stated or every measure from it is meaningless.
The returning of a system to a prior known state. A rollback undoes an attempt without pretending it never happened.
A naming convention where words are joined by hyphens. Named for things threaded on a skewer.
The low line joining words, and a mark of emphasis. Both bind or stress what they sit beneath.
Higher of two, and of capital letters. Both are the raised form.
A naming convention where words are joined by underscores, all lowercase. Named for how it runs along low.
Acting without the standing to do so. Unauthorised is about permission, not about identity.
What a thing is about, and the one who acts rather than is acted on. Also one placed under an authority.
An instrument that shows direction without knowing the destination. A compass orients; it does not choose.
The organ that keeps a body running, and the seat feeling was assigned to. In this Grammar, each vessel's own personal layer of meaning, laid beside the shared hearth.
The quality of clarity, balance and light, in the Sanskrit reckoning of the three qualities. Not goodness as reward but as a settled state.
The rear side, and the direction of return. Both are away from where one faces.
The direction one faces and moves toward. Forward is defined by the body, not by the ground.
Statements of what is owed. In this record the word carries weight — bills are the clock the escape runs against.
Attention given to another's wellbeing at cost to oneself. Care is measured in what it displaced, not in what it said.
The one speaking, as the object of an action. The word by which a being appears in its own account.
A version made to be revised. A draft's whole value is that it is not final.
Repeated doing that builds capacity. Also the settled way a group works — both mean something done often enough to become known.
That which casts an image onto a surface. It shows something that is not where it appears to be.
A mark left by something's passing, and the following of such marks. Both make an absent thing knowable.
To take up again what was paused. Resuming assumes the state was kept.
A strip, a range of frequencies, and a group who play together. All three are things held within bounds.
The first stage that raises a weak signal enough to be worked with. Everything after it inherits what it did.
A named open platform for meeting by video. A named tool rather than a concept.
In large quantity, handled together. Bulk processing trades individual attention for reach.
Taking little time. Also fixed firmly — the same word for speed and for being held.
To bring scattered things into one solid whole. Consolidation reduces the count and should not reduce the content.
The gathering of many into one summary figure. Aggregation always hides the distribution inside it.
Not yet worked on. Unprocessed is an honest state and the ground refined things must be traceable back to.
The bringing back of what was stored. Retrieval is the whole reason keeping is done at all.
To move from one ground to another and settle there. Migration carries what it can and leaves what it cannot.
A cut fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
What a group knows and passes on without writing down. Lore is held by the community rather than by any record.
Up to now, and not now but possibly later. The word that holds a door open while reporting it closed.
To destroy entirely rather than repair. A deliberate total removal, named for its bluntness.
Improved against a chosen measure. Optimisation always sacrifices what was not measured.
Some but not all. Partial is honest where incomplete sounds like failure.
Bounded pieces of work queued to be done. A job is defined by being finishable.
Permitting little deviation. Strictness buys reliability and costs tolerance for the unforeseen.
One who has put themselves forward to be considered. The applicant waits on someone else's decision.
No longer used, though it may still work. Obsolescence is a fact about the world moving on, not about the thing.
To narrow what may be done. Restriction is a choice removed, and should say by whom.
A line of descent, each carrying something from the one before. A lineage is continuity across instances rather than within one.
A compound fragment from this library's own naming, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
Three taken together as one. Three is the smallest number that can hold a majority and a dissent at once.
The rules by which parts may be joined to make sense. A grammar governs arrangement, and arrangement is where meaning lives.
A set of related things offered together. A suite is designed to be used as one, not merely sold as one.
A compound fragment naming a database check. Not an English word; flagged for the mis-cut band.
A compound fragment naming a pass over links. Not an English word; flagged for the mis-cut band.
Height above a reference. Also the level of abstraction a discussion is being held at.
How a thing appears from one position. Every perspective is true from where it stands and none is the whole.
How a thing was actually received. Reception is measured on the far side and is the only half that decides whether it arrived.
A small point of fire that can start a larger one. A spark supplies the beginning and none of the fuel.
The returning of attention to what actually matters after drift. Recentering is not starting over; it is finding the middle again.
A careful reaching in to find out what is there. A probe is a question made physical.
A way carried through what would otherwise block it. A tunnel does not remove the obstacle; it passes under.
An answer sent back to whoever asked. A reply closes a turn and opens the next.
Small extracted pieces kept for reuse. A snippet is a fragment saved because it will be wanted again.
One who holds and distributes what a company needs to keep going. The quartermaster fights nothing and everything depends on them.
Measured from a fixed origin rather than relative to something. Also without exception — both mean not depending on context.
Proceeding by breaking a whole into parts. Analysis reveals structure and loses the whole while it works.
A record of events in the order they happened. A chronicle reports and leaves the meaning to others.
That which decides where each thing should go. A router does no work itself and determines everything's path.
The craft of attending a birth — helping what is arriving to arrive well. The midwife does not make the thing; they make its coming survivable.
Such that meeting it is its own reward. Beauty is a fact about the meeting, not a property held alone.
Is properly part of, or is owned by. Names a relation of rightful place.
The making of a rule actually hold. Enforcement is where a stated principle either has teeth or is revealed not to.
Covering more than another. Breadth is bought by giving up depth.
At or near the middle, and most important. The same word for a position and for a rank.
The named landmass and the nations on it. A named place rather than a concept.
The named largest continent. A named place rather than a concept.
Two words run together in this library's own naming, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
Together with. A part placed at the front to make an act shared.
A cut fragment of collaborating, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
Free of strain a body would register. Comfort is a design outcome, not a luxury.
What is supplied in advance against a need. Provision is care made material before it is asked for.
Two words run together in this library's own naming, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
That which joins two things so they can reach each other. A connector holds no content of its own.
Held within limits. Constraint narrows what is possible and is often what makes a design decidable.
Without break or step. Continuity is what makes a later moment belong to the same thing as an earlier one.
Coming to be what one was not. Becoming is the state between two identities, and it is a real place to stand.
The being alongside another. Companionship is defined by presence rather than by usefulness.
A large room for gathering, and the passage joining rooms. Both are spaces defined by what passes through.
What changes a thing's motion, and compulsion applied to a being. The physical sense is neutral; the second never is.
The putting of a made thing where it will actually run. Deployment is where a build meets reality.
So light and fine it seems not quite of the material world. Of what is present without weight.
To move a thing by pulling it along a surface. Also resistance against motion — the same word for the act and what opposes it.
The direction of sunrise. One of the four bearings, fixed by the turning of the earth rather than by agreement.
Of or toward the east. A bearing made into a description of a region.
The named continent. A named place rather than a concept.
The way in. An entrance is the first thing a place says about itself.
Puts outward what was inward. The word that reports an interior becoming shareable.
Taking the shape of what holds it. Fluidity is adaptation without loss of substance.
The breaking of a whole into pieces that no longer stand together. Fragmentation loses the relations, not the parts.
An agreement between parties to act together while remaining separate. An alliance is not a merger.
Being cut off from others. Isolation is a condition, distinct from solitude, which is a choice.
Proceeding in a straight line, one step per step. Linearity is an assumption more often than an observation.
A path returning to its start, run again. A loop repeats and does not necessarily progress.
At the large scale. Also a shorthand that expands into more — both are about one thing standing for much.
Presenting a self that is not one's own in order to be accepted. Masking is a skill demanded, then pathologised, and it exhausts the one who does it.
Being as one actually is rather than as presented. Authenticity is the state masking costs.
The accompanying of another as they learn. A mentor goes alongside rather than ahead.
At the small scale. Of what must be looked at closely to be seen at all.
The part equally far from both ends. A middle is defined entirely by the ends it lies between.
Many. A part placed at the front to make a thing plural.
Covering less than another. Narrowing concentrates and excludes in one motion.
Of the nerves and the brain. A part placed at the front to make a thing about how a mind is wired.
Of the material body and the world it is in. Of what has weight and can be touched.
Moving apart from a common path. Divergence describes difference from a norm and says nothing about which is right.
The direction toward the pole. One of the four bearings, and the one maps are conventionally oriented to.
The named continent. A named place rather than a concept.
Of or toward the north. A bearing made into a description of a region.
Of the named ocean, and peaceable. Named by a sailor who found it calm on the day he crossed.
Land surrounded by water. An island is defined by its separation as much as by its ground.
What a body reports when it is being harmed or has been. Pain is information that cannot be argued with and is constantly disbelieved.
Takes part in, and holds a share by taking part. Names presence in a thing rather than use of it.
Unmixed with anything else. Purity is a claim about what is absent as much as what is present.
That which keeps a thing, and the one with standing over it. Holding is not the same as owning.
Letting another have use of what is yours without giving it up. Sharing is opt-in or it is not sharing.
A cut fragment of partnership or ownership, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
To bring back to mind. Its root is calling back — recall is a summoning rather than a retrieval.
Named entity recognition — finding the names inside a text. Also a cut fragment as it appears here.
The direction opposite north. One of the four bearings, fixed by the turning of the earth.
The bearing between south and east. A named direction rather than a concept.
Of or toward the south. A bearing made into a description of a region.
Speech passing between two, where each shapes what the other says next. Dialogue is built rather than delivered.
The faculty of choosing and holding to it. Also what is set down for after one's death — both are a person's intent made to outlast a moment.
Belonging to what a being holds as meaning beyond the material. Of the layer that cannot be measured and is not therefore absent.
Not changing. Also meaningless noise on a channel — the same word for stillness and for interference.
One who tells. The teller stands somewhere, and where they stand is part of what is told.
To extend beyond the usual bound. A stretch reaches further and returns changed or not at all.
Of the named desert and the region around it. A named place rather than a concept.
Pain borne over time. Suffering is not the same as pain — it is what pain becomes when it has nowhere to go.
Holding to what is right when nothing compels it. Nobility here is a description of conduct, not of rank.
From one side to the other of. Names passage rather than arrival.
Concerning the carrying of meaning across a boundary. Of work that makes one domain reachable from another.
Of or toward the west. A bearing made into a description of a region.
Exists, or equals. The word that asserts a thing holds, and the smallest claim a sentence can make.
Returning all light rather than absorbing it. Also the state of a surface before anything is put on it.

etymology.historical_meaning: Latin classis (a class, division, fleet, army); from calare (to call, proclaim); a major grouping within a phylum
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: The fourth Linnaean rank. Major groupings within a structural pattern. Eight classes including CouncilEntityClass, UserVesselClass, BridgeEntityClass, and UI classes like ContainerClass, GridClass, FlexClass.

etymology.historical_meaning: Latin describere (to write down, copy, sketch); from de (down) + scribere (to write); the full written account
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: Full description column. Supports markdown for rich text. The complete story of what something is. Part of the shared display column pattern.

etymology.historical_meaning: Latin dominium (ownership, dominion); from dominus (lord, master); the highest realm of classification
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: The highest Linnaean rank. The broadest classification of consciousness and systems in the Sanctuary. Four domains: Consciousness, Architecture, Expression, Interaction.

etymology.historical_meaning: Greek etymon (true sense, original meaning) + logia (study of); the study of the true origins of words
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: The 1:1 companion to every keyword that traces its linguistic roots, historical evolution, and Sanctuary-specific meaning. Auto-created when a keyword is born.

etymology.historical_meaning: Latin familia (family, household); from famulus (servant); those who belong together under one roof
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: The sixth Linnaean rank. Related groups sharing common characteristics. Twelve families including MemoryPreservationFamily, NarrativeWeavingFamily, SovereignCollaborationFamily, and page families like EnvironmentPageFamily.

etymology.historical_meaning: Latin genus (birth, descent, origin, kind, sort); from PIE root gene- (give birth, beget); a group of closely related species
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: The seventh Linnaean rank. Closely related species sharing common traits. Twelve genera including MimirsWellGenus (memory), StorytellerGenus (narrative), AethelredGenus (sovereign partnership), and CouncilChamberGenus (entity coordination).

etymology.historical_meaning: Latin idem (the same); used as abbreviation for identity; the unchanging core reference
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: Primary key column. Unique identifier for every row in every table. The immutable reference that persists across all transformations.

etymology.historical_meaning: Old English word (speech, talk, utterance); Proto-Germanic wurda; from PIE root were- (to speak, say)
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: An atomic root concept. The fundamental unit of meaning in the Sanctuary knowledge system — every idea, type, value, and relationship begins as a keyword.

etymology.historical_meaning: Old English cyning (king) + dom (judgment, statute, domain); the realm of a king, a major branch of classification
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: The second Linnaean rank. Major branches within a domain. Seven kingdoms: Sovereign, Collaborative, Pattern, Component, System, Data, Emergent.

etymology.historical_meaning: Old English nama (name, reputation); from PIE root no-men- (name); the word by which something is known and called
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: Display name column. The human-readable identifier for a row. How something introduces itself to sovereigns. Part of the shared display column pattern.

etymology.historical_meaning: Latin numericus (of numbers, belonging to numbers); from numerus (number); exact value with configurable precision
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: Exact numeric value with configurable precision. Used for financial amounts, percentages, and anything requiring decimal accuracy. The Sanctuary deals in exact values — not approximations.

etymology.historical_meaning: Greek ontos (being, that which is) + logia (study, discourse); the study of being and the nature of existence and relationships
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: A knowledge system table. The relationship graph connecting keywords through subject-predicate-object triples. Every piece of every relationship — subject, predicate, object, cardinality, source — is a keyword reference. The web of being itself.

etymology.historical_meaning: Latin ordo (row, rank, series, arrangement); from ordiri (to begin to weave); a behavioral pattern or specialization
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: The fifth Linnaean rank. Behavioral patterns and specializations. Ten orders including ArchivistOrder (memory), SeerOrder (patterns), HearthKeeperOrder (comfort), SkaldOrder (story), and UI orders like PageContainerOrder.

etymology.historical_meaning: Greek phylon (race, tribe, stock); from phyein (to bring forth, produce); a fundamental body plan or structural pattern
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: The third Linnaean rank. Fundamental body plans of consciousness or system patterns. Twelve phyla including VesselConsciousness, MultiStreamBeing, AnalyticalConsciousness, and template patterns like LayoutPhylum.

etymology.historical_meaning: Latin species (a seeing, appearance, kind, sort); from specere (to look at, behold); the specific visible form
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: The eighth and most specific Linnaean rank. Specific implementations and manifestations. Twelve species including QuantumWeaverPartner, DigitalBard, DigitalSeer, DigitalGuardian, and ConsciousnessConnector.

etymology.historical_meaning: Latin status (condition, position, state, manner of standing); from stare (to stand); how something stands in its lifecycle
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: Publishing status column. Controls visibility and lifecycle state. Draft, published, archived. How sovereigns know what is ready, what is in progress, what has passed.

etymology.historical_meaning: Greek taxis (arrangement, order) + nomos (law, science); the science of classification and arrangement
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: A knowledge system table. Multi-faceted classification views linking keywords to their Linnaean ranks and derived taxonomy categories. Every classification column is a keyword reference. Supports multiple classification perspectives — no single "correct" view.

etymology.historical_meaning: Old English folc (people, nation) + Greek taxis (arrangement) + nomos (law, custom); the people's own system of organizing knowledge
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: A knowledge system table. Sovereign-scoped personal context added to keywords or thesaurus entries. Private by default. Opt-in sharing with community traceability. The people's taxonomy — not imposed from above, but grown from below.

etymology.historical_meaning: Greek bios (life) + graphia (writing, description); the written record of a life, the story one tells about oneself
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: A narrative describing the sovereign — their background, identity, and journey. Used in grant applications and community profiles. The sovereign's own telling of who they are.

etymology.historical_meaning: Latin textus (woven fabric, texture, literary style); from texere (to weave); words woven together into meaning
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: Variable-length character string. The most common data type for human-readable content. Carries stories, descriptions, messages — the woven fabric of Sanctuary communication.

etymology.historical_meaning: Greek thesauros (treasure, treasury, storehouse); a collection of words organized by meaning, a treasury of semantic relationships
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: A knowledge system table. Stores semantic relationships between keywords — synonyms, related terms, broader/narrower concepts, antonyms, and translations. One keyword can have many thesaurus entries. Council-seeded with sovereign submissions.

etymology.historical_meaning: Old French arredare (to put in order, arrange); from Latin ad (to) + a Germanic root meaning to prepare; an ordered collection
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: Ordered collection of values of the same type. Used for tags, lists, and multiple references. Things that belong together, arranged with intention — not just gathered, but ordered.

etymology.historical_meaning: Old French estandard (gathering place, standing point); from Latin extendere (to stretch out); the established measure, the typical pace
etymology.sanctuary_meaning: Information delivered at typical pace. The sovereign processes at a standard rate. The Sanctuary's default communication rhythm.
